title: SISTEM PENDUKUNG KEPUTUSAN SELEKSI PENERIMA BEASISWA KULIAH MENGGUNAKAN METODE ELECTRE (STUDI KASUS ITBA DCC)
abstractText: Pendidikan tinggi merupakan salah satu faktor penting dalam meningkatkan kualitas sumber daya manusia.Namun, tidak semua lulusan sekolah menengah mampu melanjutkan pendidikan ke jenjang perguruan tinggikarena keterbatasan ekonomi. Untuk mengatasi hal ini, banyak institusi pendidikan memberikan bantuanbeasiswa sebagai bentuk kepedulian dan upaya menciptakan pemerataan akses pendidikan. Penelitian inibertujuan untuk menerapkan metode Elimination and Choice Expressing Reality (ELECTRE) dalam sistempendukung keputusan seleksi penerima beasiswa kuliah. Kriteria penilaian yang digunakan mencakup PrestasiAkademik, penghasilan orang tua, jumlah tanggungan orang tua, prestasi non-akademik, kondisi khusus denganbobot preferensi masing-masing. Metode penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan teknik totalsampling terhadap seluruh peserta mahasiswa yang mendaftar jalur beasiswa. Data diperoleh melaluiobservasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi. Tahapan analisis Electre meliputi pembentukan matriks keputusan,normalisasi, pembobotan, perhitungan matriks concordance dan discordance, hingga agregasi dominasi. Hasilpenelitian menunjukkan bahwa metode Electre mampu memberikan penilaian seleksi penerima beasiswa kuliahsecara objektif, di mana alternatif A3 memperoleh nilai dominasi tertinggi, disusul A5, A1, A2, dan A4.Penerapan metode Electre terbukti meningkatkan transparansi dan akurasi penilaian dibandingkan caramanual.Penelitian ini menyimpulkan bahwa Electre efektif digunakan dalam penilaian seleksi calon penerimabeasiswa dan dapat menjadi acuan strategis bagi manajemen ITBA DCC dalam menentukan siapa yang benarbenar layak menerima beasiswa kuliah.

title: Изучение методических компетенций в условиях профессиональной подготовки специалистов в области коррекционной педагогики
abstractText: The article reveals the content of the study of methodical competencies of students – future special educators. Its relevance and attention to the methodological side of professional activity is determined by the requirements of regulatory documents for the organization of special and inclusive education in the Russian Federation. Based on research in the field of educational psychology, general and special pedagogy, the author reveals the essence of the concepts of methodical competence and competencies, highlights the features of the professional and methodical activity of a special teacher, and substantiates the methods of conducting a pedagogical experiment. The analysis of the results of its ascertaining part made it possible to identify the characteristic features of the methodological competencies of special educators at different stages of professionalization. Based on the findings, the necessity of purposeful formation of methodical knowledge among future teachers from the perspective of a systematic approach and the development of methodical competencies based on a systematic orientation in methodical activities was substantiated, which was implemented in the conditions of the formative part of the pedagogical experiment. It is built taking into account the principles of systematic, activity-based, competence-based approaches to the formation of pedagogical activity, the specifics of the professional specifics of the work of a special teacher and is aimed at the step-by-step elaboration of the substantive and procedural characteristics of methodical competencies of future special educators in the course of professional education in a higher educational institution. The results of the control part of the study demonstrate the positive dynamics of the development of methodical competencies among students, show their ability to identify a methodical problem, conduct a better analysis of the situation, plan and program the solution of methodical tasks.

title: PEMETAAN PENELITIAN PERBANKAN SYARIAH DI BENGKULU: ANALISIS BIBLIOMETRIK 2015-2026
abstractText: Meningkatnya perkembangan industri perbankan syariah di Indonesia turut mendorong bertambahnya publikasi ilmiah yang membahas berbagai aspek perbankan syariah, baik pada tingkat nasional maupun daerah. Namun, hingga saat ini belum banyak penelitian yang secara khusus memetakan perkembangan kajian perbankan syariah di Bengkulu. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengidentifikasi pola kolaborasi penulis, tema-tema penelitian yang dominan, serta perkembangan fokus kajian perbankan syariah di Bengkulu selama periode 2015–2026. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan bibliometrik dengan memanfaatkan data publikasi yang diperoleh dari Google Scholar melalui aplikasi Publish or Perish menggunakan kata kunci "Islamic Banking" AND "Bengkulu". Sebanyak 500 dokumen dianalisis menggunakan VOSviewer melalui analisis co-authorship, co-occurrence, dan overlay visualization. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kajian perbankan syariah di Bengkulu berkembang melalui beberapa kelompok kolaborasi penulis yang saling terhubung dan didukung oleh sejumlah penulis yang memiliki peran sentral dalam jaringan penelitian. Pemetaan tema menghasilkan enam kelompok kajian utama dengan dominasi penelitian pada aspek kinerja perbankan syariah, literasi keuangan syariah, dan minat masyarakat terhadap layanan perbankan syariah. Selain itu, lingkungan akademik, khususnya mahasiswa dan program studi perbankan syariah, juga menjadi salah satu konteks yang banyak muncul dalam publikasi yang dianalisis. Perkembangan tema penelitian menunjukkan adanya pergeseran perhatian dari isu kelembagaan dan dampak pandemi menuju kajian mengenai generasi muda, Bank Syariah Indonesia, serta berbagai tantangan pengembangan perbankan syariah. Temuan ini memberikan gambaran mengenai struktur dan arah perkembangan penelitian perbankan syariah di Bengkulu sekaligus menjadi dasar bagi pengembangan agenda penelitian pada masa mendatang.

title: PARAMETRIK GEOMETRIK MODELLARNI AVTOMATIK SHAKLLANTIRISH ALGORITMINI ISHLAB CHIQISH VA UNI KOMPYUTER GRAFIKASI MUHITIDA AMALGA OSHIRISH
abstractText: Manual construction of parametric geometric objects requires repeatedrecalculation of coordinates, curves, and topological relations whenever designparameters change; existing approaches do not sufficiently coordinate process accuracywith computational performance. The aim is to develop an algorithm for automaticallygenerating parametric geometric models, deploy it in a computer graphics environment,and compare it with established geometric algorithms through a benchmark. Methods –axiomatic-deductive analysis, multivariable ordinary least-squares regression, linear andnonlinear programming optimization, system design, software testing, and performancemeasurement. Geometric coordinate, parameter, and topological errors were combined ina unified loss function, while the evaluation protocol used identical input conditions; theRMS coordinate error of B-spline and NURBS curves and surfaces was examinedseparately. Results – the benchmark indicator expressed by the number 64 enabled thecomputational and geometric components of automatic generation to be compared withinone testing procedure; when parameters changed in complex topologies, the algorithmconsistently reconstructed coordinates and connections. Conclusion – the unified lossfunction supports parametric model generation with controllable accuracy,reproducibility, and resource adaptability.

title: SHAHAR YO'L TARMOQLARI VA AVTOMOBIL TRAFIK TIRBANDLIGI: SABABLARI, BAHOLASH USULI VA INTEGRATSIYALANGAN YENGILLASHTIRISH STRATEGIYALARI
abstractText: Rapid urbanization, increasing motorization, and spatial concentration ofemployment and services are putting increasing pressure on urban road networks. Trafficcongestion is not only a transportation problem, but also a multidimensional urbanplanning problem that affects travel time, economic productivity, energy consumption,air quality, road safety, and social amenity. This paper explores the relationship betweenroad infrastructure and traffic congestion, identifies the main mechanisms that causerecurrent and non-recurrent congestion, and systematizes engineering, planning, policy,and digital interventions. A literature-based analytical approach is used, combiningclassical theories of demand, network balance, and bottleneck effects with recentevidence on demand management policies, intelligent transportation systems (ITS),artificial intelligence, and integrated urban mobility. The analysis shows that increasingroad capacity alone cannot guarantee sustainable reductions in congestion, as additionalcapacity may encourage additional car traffic. Road network improvements are morelikely to achieve sustainable results when combined with adaptive traffic signalmanagement, public transport prioritization, parking and demand management,coordinated land-use planning, real-time information, and multimodal accessibility. Aconceptual framework is proposed that considers road capacity, traffic demand, networktopology, control quality, and passenger behavior as interacting variables. The paperconcludes with recommendations for developing cities, which are particularly relevantfor the rapidly developing urban centers of Central Asia.

title: ENERGETIKA CHIQINDISIDAN SANOAT RESURSIGACHA: UCHUVCHI KULNING NEFT-GAZ TEXNOLOGIYALARIDAGI O‘RNI
abstractText: Fly ash, a large-tonnage solid waste of thermal power plants, has beenactively studied over the past decade as a raw material for various segments of the oil andgas industry. This article analyzes the use of fly ash in well cementing, as a functionalfiller for drilling fluids, in enhanced oil recovery, as a proppant and proppant coating, inproduced water treatment, and in foam-assisted liquid unloading from gas wells.

title: OQOVA SUVLARNI REAL VAQT REJIMIDA NAZORAT QILISHDA ONLAYN SENSORLARDAN FOYDALANISH SAMARADORLIGINI
abstractText: This article examines the scientific and practical effectiveness of usingonline sensors for real-time wastewater monitoring. The study compares traditionallaboratory-based wastewater quality assessment with continuous sensor-basedmonitoring systems. Particular attention is paid to the continuous measurement of pH,temperature, electrical conductivity, turbidity, dissolved oxygen, chemical oxygendemand and wastewater flow. The main efficiency criteria include data acquisition speed,monitoring continuity, early-warning capability, reduction of human intervention, dataaccuracy and operational costs. The study also considers the integration of online sensorswith Internet of Things technologies, enabling remote data transmission and automateddecision-making. The results demonstrate that real-time monitoring can improve theresponsiveness of wastewater management systems and facilitate earlier identification ofenvironmental risks

title: ВАРИАЦИИ СОДЕРЖАНИЯ РАДОНА В ПОЧВЕ И МЕТЕОРОЛОГИЧЕСКИХ ПАРАМЕТРОВ В ОБСЕРВАТОРИИ ЯНГИБАЗАР В 2022–2025 ГОДАХ
abstractText: This paper presents the results of continuous observations of soil radoncontent, air humidity, and atmospheric pressure at the Yangibazar Observatory during2022–2025. The main objective of the study is to identify the temporal patterns of radonvariability and to assess the relationship between the observed variations and seasonaland geodynamic processes. Radon flux density was measured using an RR-3s radonmonitor installed in a borehole approximately 1 m deep. Analysis of daily, monthly, andannual values revealed a stable seasonal pattern in soil radon variability. During 2022–2024, the maximum radon flux density values reached 15.8–17.4 Bq/m²·s, whereas themaximum value in 2025 was 14.3 Bq/m²·s. No sharp and prolonged changes in radoncontent were identified during the observation period. The observed variations werepredominantly seasonal, indicating the importance of considering meteorological factors,particularly air humidity and atmospheric pressure, when interpreting radon variations.The obtained results demonstrate the need for an integrated analysis of radon monitoringdata together with meteorological and geodynamic parameters in studies of seismicprocesses.

title: Parenting Styles and Developmental Screening Categories Among Young Children in Sukabumi
abstractText: Background: Developmental screening and responsive caregiving are essential components of early childhood healthcare. Parenting styles may be associated with developmental screening outcomes. Objectives: To examine the association between parenting styles and developmental screening categories among children aged 2 to 5 years in Sukabumi, Indonesia. Methods: This quantitative cross sectional study included 260 mother–child pairs recruited through reported cluster random sampling. Parenting styles were assessed using the Parenting Styles and Dimensions Questionnaire, while development was screened using the Kuesioner Pra Skrining Perkembangan. Associations were analyzed using Pearson chi square and Cramér’s V. Results: Authoritative, authoritarian, and permissive parenting accounted for 49.6%, 24.2%, and 26.2% of participants, respectively. Developmental screening indicated normal findings in 67.7%, suspect findings in 24.2%, and delay findings in 8.1%. A significant association was observed (X² = 21.148; df = 4; p < 0.001; Cramér’s V = 0.202). Suspect findings were highest with authoritarian parenting (41.3%), while delay findings were highest with permissive parenting (14.7%). Conclusions: Parenting styles were associated with developmental screening categories. Findings support caregiver counseling and routine developmental screening but do not establish causality.

title: Otago Exercise for Fall Prevention in Older Adults A Narrative Literature Review
abstractText: Background: Falls threaten independence in older adults, highlighting the need for evidence based exercise interventions. Objectives: To examine evidence on the Otago Exercise Program (OEP) for improving balance, mobility, and fall prevention among older adults. Methods: A narrative literature review examined ten selected reports published between 2021 and 2025, identified through PubMed, ScienceDirect, and Google Scholar. Evidence was categorized by study design, distinguishing controlled studies, uncontrolled studies, a case report, and a trial protocol. Actual falls were analyzed separately from functional assessment outcomes. Results: Nine reports provided intervention outcomes, while one described a planned trial. Short studies generally reported improvements in balance or mobility, including a Berg Balance Scale increase from 37.36 to 48.73 in an uncontrolled study. A Spanish randomized trial comparing group and individual delivery found a 12 month difference in reported falls of -0.58 percentage points (90% confidence interval: -6.54 to 5.39). This comparison evaluated delivery formats rather than effectiveness against usual care. Conclusions: Individually adapted OEP may support fall prevention strategies, although evidence should be interpreted according to study design. Future implementation should monitor adherence, functional outcomes, actual falls, and adverse events.

title: Potential of Aurelia aurita Extract in Reducing Oxidative Stress in Osteoarthritis
abstractText: Background: Oxidative stress contributes to osteoarthritis progression, supporting investigation of marine preparations as potential sources of bioactive compounds. Objectives: To characterize an Aurelia aurita preparation from Kenjeran Beach, Surabaya, and evaluate plasma malondialdehyde concentrations in rats with chemically induced osteoarthritis. Methods: A posttest only experimental design included an untreated osteoarthritis control and three groups receiving oral A. aurita preparation at 2.5, 5, or 10 mg/kg body weight for seven days. Five male Wistar rats were included per group. The preparation was characterized using gas chromatography mass spectrometry and a DPPH radical scavenging assay. Results: Fifteen chromatographic entries were identified. Mean plasma malondialdehyde concentrations were 211.1 ± 36.3, 142.0 ± 20.3, 279.7 ± 68.2, and 320.6 ± 14.53 nmol/L for the control, 2.5, 5, and 10 mg/kg groups, respectively. ANOVA showed significant between group differences (F(3,16)=18.71; p<0.001), supported by Welch analysis. The 2.5 mg/kg group was 69.1 nmol/L lower than control, whereas higher doses showed increased concentrations. Conclusions: The lowest tested dose warrants further investigation. Dose optimization, chemical standardization, and safety evaluation are required before clinical translation.

title: Implementation of the No Smoking Area Policy in Four Secondary Schools in Surakarta
abstractText: Background: Schools are designated settings for the No Smoking Area (Kawasan Tanpa Rokok, KTR) policy. Objective: To describe implementation processes through communication, resources, disposition, and bureaucratic structure. Methods: A descriptive qualitative study included 19 purposively selected informants at SMA N 2 Surakarta, SMK Kristen, SMK N 8 Surakarta, and SMK Marsudirini. Structured interviews with open responses were conducted from April to June 2025. Interactive analysis involved data reduction, presentation, and conclusion verification; source triangulation compared stakeholder perspectives. Results: Communication included ceremonies, classroom guidance, and posters, with differing accounts of its continuity. Resources relied on existing personnel; informants reported limited signage and no dedicated budget. Disposition included support and reprimands alongside reports of teachers smoking. Bureaucratic structure used existing counseling and supervisory roles, with reported gaps in dedicated procedures and coordination. Findings describe stakeholder accounts rather than school rankings or measured policy effects. Conclusion: Clear recurring communication, explicit resource responsibilities, consistent adult example, and written operational procedures are priorities for strengthening KTR implementation in the participating schools.

title: Retrospective Perioperative Profile of Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy at Ibnu Sina Teaching Hospital in 2025
abstractText: Background: Local perioperative profiles can support service evaluation and improve documentation of patients undergoing laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Objectives: To describe the demographic, clinical, anesthetic, and perioperative characteristics of patients undergoing laparoscopic cholecystectomy at Ibnu Sina Teaching Hospital, Makassar. Methods: A retrospective descriptive cross sectional review included procedures performed from January 1 to December 25, 2025. Total sampling identified 45 records, of which 40 met the eligibility criteria. Demographics, body mass index, indications, comorbidities, intraoperative findings, anesthesia categories, pain scores, and length of hospital stay were summarized using frequencies and percentages. Results: Women comprised 31 patients (77.5%), and 26 (65.0%) were aged over 40 years. Acute cholecystitis was the most frequent indication (55.0%), while gallstones with gallbladder distension were recorded in 55.0%. Regional anesthesia was recorded in 23 cases (57.5%) and general anesthesia in 17 (42.5%). Pain scores of 4–6 occurred in 24 cases (60.0%). Hospital stay was >/3 days in 35 cases (87.5%). Conclusions: The findings describe the perioperative profile of eligible laparoscopic cholecystectomy cases and provide a baseline for standardized documentation and prospective clinical audit.

title: LDL Cholesterol, Hypertension, and Stroke Subtype among Hospitalized Patients in Palangka Raya
abstractText: Background: Low density lipoprotein cholesterol and hypertension are established vascular risk factors, but their associations with stroke subtype require careful evaluation in hospital based populations. Objectives: To examine associations of LDL cholesterol and hypertension with ischemic versus other stroke diagnoses among hospitalized stroke patients. Methods: This observational cross sectional study analyzed retrospective records from RSUD dr. Doris Sylvanus, Palangka Raya, from January to December 2024. Purposive sampling included 142 of 352 records, comprising 107 ischemic and 35 other stroke diagnoses. Unadjusted odds ratios (ORs), 95% confidence intervals (CIs), and two sided tests were calculated from aggregate counts. Results: High LDL was associated with ischemic stroke classification (OR 2.90; 95% CI 1.26–6.67; p=0.010). Reconstruction from the internally consistent joint exposure table yielded an OR of 2.74 for hypertension (95% CI 1.17–6.38; p=0.017). Compared with normal LDL without hypertension, high LDL with hypertension had OR 4.00 (95% CI 1.57–10.22; Fisher p=0.004). Hypertension counts require confirmation because source tables were inconsistent. Conclusions: High LDL was associated with greater odds of ischemic rather than other stroke diagnoses. These analyses do not establish incidence, causality, independent effects, or interaction.

title: HbA1c and Peripheral Sensory Loss in Relation to Diabetic Foot Screening Findings
abstractText: complications and care needs among people with diabetes. Objectives: To examine associations of HbA1c and peripheral sensory loss with abnormal foot screening findings among Persadia members at PKU Muhammadiyah Gamping Hospital. Methods: This quantitative cross sectional study included 36 participants selected by total sampling. HbA1c measurement, 10 g monofilament examination, and standardized foot observation were performed. HbA1c was categorized as <7% or >/7%. Frequencies, contingency tables, odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals, and two sided Fisher exact tests were analyzed. Results: Twenty seven participants had HbA1c <7%, and 13 had abnormal foot screening findings. Abnormal findings occurred in 4 of 9 participants with HbA1c >/7% and 9 of 27 with HbA1c <7% (OR 1.60; 95% CI 0.34–7.46; p=0.693). Recalculation of the reported sensory loss table yielded OR 3.09 (95% CI 0.71–13.47; p=0.153), although the sensory loss table requires reconciliation with the descriptive neuropathy counts. Conclusions: Neither HbA1c category nor peripheral sensory loss showed a statistically significant association with abnormal foot screening findings. Glycemic monitoring and standardized foot assessment remain complementary components of diabetes care.

title: Unexpected Uterine Leiomyosarcoma After Hysterectomy for Presumed Leiomyoma: A Case Report
abstractText: Background: Uterine leiomyosarcoma is a rare malignant smooth muscle tumor that may remain unsuspected until definitive histopathological examination. Objectives: To describe diagnostic discordance between benign preoperative and gross impressions and malignant microscopic findings in uterine leiomyosarcoma. Methods: This case report retrospectively describes clinical presentation, computed tomography findings, surgical management, histopathological examination, and immunohistochemical results. Results: A 47 year old multiparous woman presented with six months of progressive abnormal uterine bleeding and abdominal enlargement. Non contrast computed tomography revealed a well circumscribed intramural uterine mass measuring 7.0 × 6.8 × 7.0 cm without detectable extrauterine disease. Total abdominal hysterectomy was performed for presumed leiomyoma. Gross examination revealed a firm whorled mass without evident hemorrhage or geographic necrosis. Microscopy demonstrated moderate to severe cytologic atypia, coagulative tumor cell necrosis, and more than 10 mitoses per 10 high power fields. Strong desmin and h caldesmon positivity supported smooth muscle differentiation. The patient was referred for multidisciplinary oncologic assessment. Conclusions: Benign appearing imaging and gross morphology cannot exclude uterine leiomyosarcoma. Accurate diagnosis requires adequate histological sampling and integrated clinicopathological assessment.

title: Coping and Spirituality in Relation to Quality of Life Among Patients Undergoing Hemodialysis
abstractText: Background: Hemodialysis imposes substantial physical and psychosocial demands that may affect patients' quality of life. Objectives: To examine associations between coping mechanisms, spirituality, and quality of life among patients with chronic kidney disease at Sekarwangi Regional General Hospital, Sukabumi Regency. Methods: This quantitative cross sectional study recruited 100 patients through accidental sampling. Data were collected using the Brief COPE, Daily Spiritual Experience Scale, and Kidney Disease Quality of Life instruments. Descriptive statistics and exact contingency tests were applied, with approximate 95% confidence intervals for differences in proportions. Results: Adaptive coping was reported in 91 patients, high spirituality in 59, and good quality of life in 60. Good quality of life occurred in 60 of 91 patients with adaptive coping versus none of nine with maladaptive coping (difference 65.9 percentage points; 95% confidence interval 34.3–74.8; Fisher exact p < 0.001). Corresponding counts were 59/59 for high spirituality, 1/28 for medium spirituality, and 0/13 for low spirituality (overall exact p < 0.001). Conclusions: Coping mechanisms and spirituality were significantly associated with quality of life. Individualized nursing assessment and further evaluation of psychosocial and spiritual interventions are warranted, although causal relationships cannot be established.

title: Recurrent Stroke Like Episodes in a Young Woman with Multiple Dural Arteriovenous Fistulas
abstractText: Background: Intracranial dural arteriovenous fistulas (dAVFs) may cause progressive headaches, neurological deficits, and serious complications related to abnormal venous drainage. Objectives: To describe the clinical progression, angiographic findings, treatment response, and complications in a young woman with multiple intracranial dAVFs. Methods: A descriptive case review integrated serial clinical assessments, computed tomography, digital subtraction angiography, magnetic resonance imaging, and endovascular treatment records. Results: A 23 year old woman presented with progressive pulsatile occipital headache, left sided weakness, and visual disturbances. Computed tomography revealed hyperdensity and surrounding edema. Angiography identified multiple dAVFs involving the left transverse and superior sagittal sinuses, supplied by bilateral middle meningeal and occipital arteries. Staged embolization temporarily improved symptoms and reduced shunt flow. Recurrent seizures required additional embolization. Three months after discharge, seizures and impaired consciousness recurred. Magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated superior sagittal sinus thrombosis and intraventricular hemorrhage. Further intervention was delayed, followed by neurological deterioration. Conclusions: Multiple intracranial dAVFs may demonstrate complex clinical progression despite initial treatment response. Sustained angiographic surveillance, timely reassessment, and multidisciplinary management are essential considerations for detecting persistent vascular abnormalities and potentially serious complications.

title: Exploratory Comparison of 10% NBF and Methanol Fixation in Adenomyosis Uterine Tissue
abstractText: Background: Fixation is critical for routine histology, but alternative alcohol fixatives may produce different staining characteristics from 10% neutral buffered formalin. Objectives: This exploratory laboratory study compared hematoxylin and eosin staining quality in adenomyosis uterine tissue from two hysterectomy donors. Methods: Forty histology slides were evaluated, with 20 slides in the 10% neutral buffered formalin group and 20 in the methanol group. Nuclear, cytoplasmic, and cell boundary staining were scored as adequate or good by light microscopy at 10x and 40x magnification. Results: Good scores were more frequent with formalin than methanol for nuclei (60.0% vs 25.0%), cytoplasm (65.0% vs 20.0%), and cell boundaries (70.0% vs 25.0%). Mann Whitney output showed asymptotic p values of 0.027, 0.004, and 0.005, respectively; the reported exact value for nuclear staining was 0.060 and was not corrected for ties. Conclusions: Because only two biological donors contributed the slides, findings are interpreted descriptively as a pilot comparison. Under the tested laboratory conditions, formalin showed more favorable slide level staining scores, while confirmation in a larger donor series with standardized allocation and masked scoring is required.

title: The Relationship Between Self Control and Bullying Behavior Among Adolescents at SMPN 1 Cikembar in the Cikembar Community Health Center Service Area, Sukabumi Regency
abstractText: Background: Bullying remains a significant adolescent health and school safety concern. Self control may influence students' behavioral regulation and involvement in bullying. Objectives: This study examined the association between self control and bullying behavior among students at SMPN 1 Cikembar, Sukabumi Regency, Indonesia. Methods: A correlational cross sectional study included 293 students selected from a population of 1,059 using proportional stratified random sampling. Self control and bullying behavior were assessed using questionnaires based on the Brief Self Control Scale and Revised Olweus Bully/Victim Questionnaire. Associations were analyzed using the Chi square test and prevalence ratios (PR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI). Results: High self control was reported by 185 students (63.1%), while 184 (62.8%) demonstrated low bullying behavior. High bullying behavior occurred in 56.5% of students with low self control compared with 25.9% of those with high self control. Low self control was significantly associated with higher bullying prevalence (PR = 2.18; 95% CI: 1.62–2.92; X² = 27.22; p < 0.001). Conclusions: Lower self control was significantly associated with bullying behavior, without establishing causality. School prevention programs should integrate behavioral assessment, counseling, and coordinated teacher and parent support.

title: Self Confidence and Resilience Among Emergency NursesSelf Confidence and Resilience Among Emergency Nurses
abstractText: Background: Emergency nurses in earthquake prone regions require psychological resources to maintain resilience, manage occupational stress, and deliver effective care during disasters. Self confidence may contribute to their ability to adapt to challenging clinical situations. Objectives: This study examined the association between self confidence and resilience among emergency department nurses at Sayang Regional General Hospital, Cianjur Regency, Indonesia. Methods: A quantitative cross sectional study involved 50 emergency department nurses recruited through total sampling. Self confidence and resilience were assessed using structured questionnaires. Associations were examined using the Chi square test, with odds ratios (OR) and 95% confidence intervals (CI) calculated to estimate association strength. Results: High self confidence was reported by 34 nurses (68.0%), while 35 nurses (70.0%) demonstrated high resilience. Statistical analysis revealed a significant association between self confidence and resilience (p = 0.005; OR = 6.00; 95% CI: 1.60–22.55), indicating greater odds of high resilience among nurses with high self confidence. Conclusion: Self confidence was significantly associated with resilience among emergency nurses. Integrating psychological capacity building into hospital disaster preparedness programs may strengthen nurses' adaptive capabilities and support emergency care readiness.

title: Determinants of Community Compliance With COVID 19 Health Protocols in Indonesia: An Integrative Literature Review
abstractText: Background: Community compliance with health protocols was essential during the early COVID 19 pandemic. Understanding its determinants may inform preparedness for future respiratory outbreaks. Objectives: This integrative literature review synthesized Indonesian evidence on factors associated with community compliance with COVID 19 preventive protocols. Methods: Google Scholar was the documented search source. Of 31 initially identified records, 16 remained after restriction, and six studies met eligibility criteria. Eligible studies examined community compliance with preventive protocols and provided accessible full text. Findings were synthesized descriptively using a Health Belief Model informed framework. Results: Across six studies, compliance was associated with cognitive factors, including knowledge, awareness, perceived threat, and perceived barriers; motivational and social factors, including attitudes, concern, motivation, and social environment; and structural factors, particularly facility availability. Findings varied across study settings, suggesting that compliance reflected interactions among individual perceptions, social influences, and environmental opportunities. Conclusions: Community compliance during the early pandemic was associated with interconnected cognitive, motivational, social, and structural factors. These findings provide contextual lessons for designing integrated health promotion strategies and strengthening preparedness for future respiratory outbreaks.

title: CBIA Education for Leprosy Knowledge, Attitudes, and Practices Among Health Cadres: A Quasi Experimental Study
abstractText: Background: Community health cadres play an important role in leprosy control through health education and patient support in endemic areas. Objectives: This study evaluated changes in cadres' knowledge, attitudes, and practices following Cara Belajar Insan Aktif (CBIA) education. Methods: A nonrandomized quasi experimental time series study involved 70 cadres in Tombariri District, equally allocated to intervention and control groups. The intervention included standardized booklets, teaching aids, facilitated discussions, and plenary clarification. Outcomes were assessed at baseline, immediately after education, one month, and three months. Results: At three months, favorable knowledge increased from 46.0% to 71.0%, attitudes from 37.0% to 63.0%, and practices from 31.0% to 51.0% in the intervention group. Significant between group differences were observed for knowledge at three months (p < 0.001), attitudes at one month (p = 0.004), and practices at one month (p = 0.003). Baseline attitudes also differed significantly (p < 0.001). Conclusions: CBIA education was associated with improved cadre outcomes. However, baseline imbalance and declining attitude and practice gains suggest that sustained reinforcement and cautious interpretation are necessary.

title: The Relationship Between Axial Length and Age in Patients with Congenital Cataract
abstractText: Background: Congenital cataract can impair visual development, while axial length is an important parameter in pediatric ocular assessment. Objectives: This study examined the relationship between axial length and age among patients diagnosed with congenital cataract. Methods: A retrospective analytical cross-sectional study reviewed medical records from Dr. Soetomo General Hospital, Surabaya, Indonesia, between January 2021 and December 2022. Total sampling included 24 patients. Descriptive statistics, Spearman correlation, and paired t-tests were reported. Results: Patients ranged from 2 months to 17 years (mean age, 3.35 years). Thirteen patients had unilateral cataract and 11 had bilateral cataract, involving 35 affected eyes. Mean axial lengths were 20.71 ± 2.16 mm in 17 right eyes and 20.82 ± 1.93 mm in 18 left eyes. The reported age–axial-length correlation could not be reliably interpreted because the correlation coefficient and P value were inconsistent, and the analytical unit was unclear. Conclusions: These findings describe axial length characteristics among pediatric patients with congenital cataract but cannot establish the relationship between age and axial length. Verification of patient-level data and reanalysis accounting for bilateral eye measurements are necessary.

title: Knowledge of Midwifery Instruments Following Use of the Informasi Instrumen Kebidanan Digital Book: A Quasi Experimental Study
abstractText: Background: A digital book may support learning instrument names and functions, but knowledge scores do not establish practical competence. Objective: To compare immediate posttest instrument knowledge between INSTADAN and lecturer PowerPoint groups after baseline adjustment. Methods: This nonrandomized study analyzed 161 first year midwifery students from four intact classes (INSTADAN, n=78; control, n=83). A 30 item knowledge test was administered before and after teaching. Individual level ANCOVA adjusted for pretest score, age, and information sources with HC3 standard errors. Results: Mean scores rose from 68.72 to 85.04 with INSTADAN and from 68.84 to 79.88 with PowerPoint. The adjusted difference was 6.08 points (95% CI, 3.99 to 8.17; P<0.001), equivalent to approximately 1.82 correct answers. Student stratified bootstrap gave a 95% interval of 4.05 to 8.14 points. Neither method adjusted for class dependence. Conclusion: INSTADAN was associated with higher immediate knowledge scores; four class allocation, baseline imbalance, and incomplete assessment documentation limit causal interpretation. Retention and practical competence were not examined.

title: Development and Functional Testing of a Web Based Dengue Weather Alert Prototype with WhatsApp Notifications in Palu, Indonesia
abstractText: Background: Weather information may support dengue preparedness, although software functionality alone cannot establish forecasting accuracy. Objectives: This study developed a web based weather alert prototype integrating meteorological data and WhatsApp notifications for dengue preparedness in Palu, Indonesia. Methods: Research and development followed the Analysis, Design, and Development phases of the ADDIE model from January 14 to February 4, 2026. CodeIgniter 4 and MySQL supported coordinate based weather retrieval through OpenWeather, data storage, user registration, and automated notifications. Results: The prototype covered 46 urban villages across eight districts. Nine functional testing categories were reported as successful, including website accessibility, geographic data, weather integration, storage, notifications, decision logic, registration, profile management, and interface responsiveness. However, detailed test inputs, execution counts, and notification delivery receipts were unavailable. The 22 day development period could not independently establish a complete 30 day rainfall dataset without historical records. Weather thresholds remained literature informed assumptions without local predictive validation. Conclusions: The prototype demonstrated preliminary software integration capabilities. Reproducible functional testing, rainfall data verification, governance safeguards, and independent epidemiological validation are required before operational implementation for dengue preparedness.

title: Assessing Emergency Department Crowding: A Structured Literature Review of the National Emergency Department Overcrowding Score
abstractText: Background: Emergency department crowding requires reliable measurement to distinguish operational pressure from patient severity and clinical outcomes. Objectives: This review evaluated evidence regarding the National Emergency Department Overcrowding Score (NEDOCS) and its potential application in emergency service evaluation. Methods: A structured narrative review examined eight previously selected studies within the reported 2021–2026 eligibility period. Searches reportedly covered PubMed, ScienceDirect, Taylor & Francis, and ProQuest, identifying 126 records. Search dates and several selection procedures remained unverified. Findings were synthesized across crowding perceptions, workload, waiting and boarding, and leaving without being seen. Results: NEDOCS demonstrated agreement with staff perceptions in some settings, while associations with alternative crowding indices and waiting times varied. Workload findings relied on repeated questionnaires, and pediatric leaving without being seen was associated with crowding in adjusted observational analysis. Simulated boarding removal reduced calculated scores without demonstrating clinical benefits. Methodological heterogeneity and incomplete review documentation limited interpretation. Conclusions: NEDOCS may complement existing emergency department performance indicators, but evidence does not establish its effectiveness at Dr. Soeradji Tirtonegoro General Hospital. Local validation, standardized outcome measurement, and transparent review documentation are necessary before implementation.

title: Development of an Instrument to Assess Service Quality and Resource Adequacy in Midwifery Laboratories
abstractText: Background: Midwifery laboratories are essential for developing clinical competencies, yet service quality and resource adequacy are frequently assessed separately. Objectives: This study aimed to develop and internally evaluate an integrated instrument for assessing midwifery laboratory quality. Methods: Five experts validated the instrument, and 446 midwifery students with laboratory experience completed a 44 item questionnaire. Psychometric evaluation included content validity, exploratory factor analysis (EFA), preliminary confirmatory factor analysis (CFA), Rasch analysis, and internal consistency testing. Results: The average scale content validity index was 0.982. EFA identified six factors explaining 56.96% of total variance, with the first factor contributing 44.02%. Preliminary CFA demonstrated X²/df = 2.240, RMSEA = 0.053, SRMR = 0.041, GFI = 0.991, CFI = 0.898, and TLI = 0.886. Rasch person reliability was 0.969, whereas item reliability was 0.641. Cronbach alpha reached 0.970, with corrected item total correlations ranging from 0.561 to 0.739. Conclusions: The instrument demonstrated promising internal psychometric properties for evaluating midwifery laboratory quality. However, independent external validation and comprehensive ordinal and Rasch diagnostics remain necessary before broader implementation.

title: EVALUASI KESESUAIAN INFORMASI LAYANAN SERTIFIKASI HALAL PADA PUSAT HALAL UIN FATMAWATI SUKARNO BENGKULU: ANALISIS DOKUMEN BERBASIS REGULASI
abstractText: Informasi mengenai prosedur sertifikasi halal perlu disajikan secara jelas dan mengacu pada regulasi yang berlaku agar dapat menjadi pedoman bagi pelaku usaha maupun pihak yang terlibat dalam penyelenggaraan layanan. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengevaluasi kesesuaian informasi dalam Pedoman Pusat Halal LPPM UIN Fatmawati Sukarno Bengkulu tahun 2026 dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan yang relevan. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif melalui analisis dokumen. Dokumen pedoman ditelaah dengan memperhatikan dasar hukum, penjelasan jalur sertifikasi halal, persyaratan administrasi, tahapan layanan, serta pembagian peran lembaga yang terlibat. Hasil telaah menunjukkan bahwa pedoman telah memuat informasi dasar mengenai jalur pernyataan halal (self-declare) dan jalur reguler, termasuk sejumlah persyaratan serta tahapan pengajuan. Meskipun demikian, terdapat bagian yang memerlukan peninjauan, terutama pencantuman dasar hukum, penggunaan nomenklatur peraturan, ketepatan alamat sistem pengajuan, dan penjelasan mengenai persyaratan layanan. Salah satu persoalan penting ialah penggunaan Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 39 Tahun 2021 sebagai rujukan, padahal peraturan tersebut telah dicabut dan digantikan oleh Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 42 Tahun 2024. Temuan ini menunjukkan perlunya pembaruan dan pemeriksaan silang terhadap informasi dalam pedoman. Evaluasi ini terbatas pada isi dokumen dan tidak dimaksudkan untuk menilai efektivitas pelaksanaan layanan di lapangan.
venueName: FISKAL: Jurnal Ekonomi, Bisnis, dan Manajemen

title: Mitigasi Bencana Banjir dan Longsor Melalui Pendekatan Vegetatif Partisipatif Sebagai Wujud Kolaborasi Perguruan Tinggi dan Desa di Padukuhan Mojolegi
abstractText: Padukuhan Mojolegi, Kalurahan Karangtengah, Imogiri, Bantul, rentan terhadap dua bencana hidrometeorologi sekaligus, yaitu banjir di dataran rendah (RT 1 dan RT 2) dan tanah longsor di lereng dataran tinggi (RT 5 dan RT 6), sementara mitigasi struktural membutuhkan biaya besar. Kegiatan pengabdian melalui Kuliah Kerja Nyata ini bertujuan menerapkan mitigasi non-struktural berbasis vegetasi secara partisipatif pada dua skala, yaitu pekarangan rumah tangga dan lahan kritis komunal. Dengan pendekatan Participatory Action Research bersama Forum Pengurangan Risiko Bencana (FPRB) dan Kelompok Wanita Tani (PKWT), kegiatan dilaksanakan dalam tiga tahap: pemetaan risiko spasial, edukasi mitigasi domestik pada 25 Januari 2026, dan penanaman komunal pada 31 Januari 2026. Pada skala rumah tangga, 12 bibit sirsak dibagikan kepada anggota PKWT di RT 2 hingga RT 6 untuk ditanam di pekarangan sebagai upaya meningkatkan intersepsi dan infiltrasi air hujan di wilayah hulu kawasan banjir. Pada skala komunal, warga dan FPRB menanam 80 bibit vetiver sebagai barisan pencegat di lereng curam RT 6 serta 10 bibit bambu dan 8 bibit trembesi di perbukitan RT 5; sisa 40 bibit vetiver, 4 bambu, 2 trembesi, dan 2 sirsak diserahkan kepada FPRB untuk ditanam secara mandiri. Integrasi mitigasi domestik dan komunal yang diarahkan oleh peta risiko merupakan model mitigasi berbasis alam yang murah dan dapat direplikasi, tetapi efektivitasnya perlu dibuktikan melalui pemantauan kelangsungan hidup tanaman, erosi, dan kejadian banjir dalam jangka panjang.

title: Penurunan Kekhawatiran Orangtua Terhadap Kenakalan Remaja melalui Psikoedukasi Pola Asuh
abstractText: Kekhawatiran orang tua terhadap kenakalan remaja dapat mendorong pengasuhan yang terlalu mengontrol, padahal kontrol psikologis dan pengasuhan overprotektif justru berhubungan dengan kecemasan dan perilaku eksternalisasi remaja. Kegiatan pengabdian ini bertujuan meningkatkan pengetahuan orang tua tentang pola asuh, komunikasi, dan manajemen emosi remaja sebagai upaya pencegahan kenakalan remaja dan pengelolaan kekhawatiran secara adaptif. Psikoedukasi berbasis modul Menjadi Orang Tua Kekinian dari HIMPSI dan Wahana Visi Indonesia diberikan pada 24 Juni 2026 di Masjid Al-Falah, Padukuhan Sombangan, Sumbersari, Moyudan, Sleman, kepada orang tua yang memiliki anak usia 12–18 tahun. Evaluasi menggunakan desain pre-test dan post-test satu kelompok dengan kuesioner pengetahuan lima butir, dan 17 orang tua dengan data lengkap dianalisis menggunakan uji Wilcoxon signed-rank. Median skor pengetahuan meningkat dari 2 (rentang 1–3) menjadi 5 (rentang 3–5), dan perbedaan tersebut bermakna secara statistik (p = 0,001). Psikoedukasi pola asuh singkat efektif meningkatkan pengetahuan orang tua dan berpotensi menjadi strategi preventif berbasis komunitas, tetapi pengaruhnya terhadap tingkat kekhawatiran, praktik pengasuhan, dan perilaku remaja perlu diukur secara langsung dalam evaluasi lanjutan.

title: Meningkatkan Kesejahteraan Lansia dengan Psikoedukasi dan Program Pembentukan Taman Lansia
abstractText: Abstrak Peningkatan jumlah lansia menuntut kesiapan lingkungan dalam mendukung tugas perkembangan mereka. Di Padukuhan G II, lansia menghadapi permasalahan kesejahteraan psikologis (psychological well-being) yang rendah, yang ditandai dengan perasaan tidak berguna, rendahnya aktualisasi diri, serta keterbatasan dukungan sosial dari keluarga dan kader yang cenderung lebih berfokus pada kesehatan fisik. Tujuan: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan pengetahuan, kesadaran, dan dukungan sosial demi tercapainya kesejahteraan psikologis dan aktualisasi diri lansia melalui program intervensi komunitas. Metode: Asesmen dilakukan menggunakan metode wawancara, observasi, dan Focus Group Discussion (FGD) yang melibatkan 13 peserta (dukuh, kader, lansia, dan keluarga). Intervensi yang diberikan kepada 46 lansia meliputi psikoedukasi, inisiasi program "Taman Lansia", kampanye media, serta evaluasi. Hasil: Analisis kuantitatif menunjukkan adanya peningkatan rerata skor pengetahuan dari pre-test sebesar 7,17 (SD = 1,596) menjadi 8,41 (SD = 1,185) pada post-test. Secara kualitatif, terjadi peningkatan kesadaran keluarga dalam membangun interaksi dan mengingatkan jadwal kegiatan lansia. Kader juga mulai memperhatikan aspek psikologis lansia. Dampak intervensi terlihat dari peningkatan kehadiran lansia dalam kegiatan sosial (pengajian dan posyandu) serta kepatuhan dalam mengonsumsi obat. Simpulan: Intervensi komunitas melalui psikoedukasi dan inisiasi program Taman Lansia efektif meningkatkan kesejahteraan psikologis, dukungan sosial, dan membuka peluang aktualisasi diri bagi lansia di Padukuhan G II. Kata Kunci Kesejahteraan Psikologis, Aktualisasi Diri, Lansia, Intervensi Komunitas, Psikoedukasi. Abstract The increasing number of elderly populations demands environmental readiness to support their developmental tasks. In Padukuhan G II, the elderly faced low psychological well-being, characterized by feelings of uselessness, low self-actualization, and limited social support from families and cadres who predominantly focused on physical health. Objective: This study aimed to improve knowledge, awareness, and social support to achieve psychological well-being and self-actualization among the elderly through a community intervention program. Method: The assessment was conducted using interviews, observations, and Focus Group Discussions (FGD) involving 13 participants (village head, cadres, elderly, and family members). The intervention delivered to 46 elderly participants consisted of psychoeducation, the initiation of the "Taman Lansia" (Elderly Park) program, media campaigns, and follow-up evaluation. Results: Quantitative analysis showed an increase in the mean score of knowledge from the pre-test at 7.17 (SD = 1.596) to 8.41 (SD = 1.185) in the post-test. Qualitatively, there was an increase in family awareness regarding interaction and reminding the elderly of social schedules. Cadres also began to consider the psychological aspects of the elderly. The intervention's impact was reflected in the increased attendance of the elderly in social activities (recitations and posyandu) and compliance with taking medication. Conclusion: Community intervention through psychoeducation and the initiation of the Taman Lansia program is effective in enhancing psychological well-being, social support, and opening opportunities for self-actualization among the elderly in Padukuhan G II. ​Keywords: Psychological Well-Being, Self-Actualization, Elderly, Community Intervention, Psychoeducation.

title: Peningkatan Pemahaman Orang Tua tentang Penggunaan Gadget pada Anak Usia Dini melalui Psikoedukasi di Padukuhan X
abstractText: Penggunaan gadget pada anak usia dini menjadi salah satu permasalahan yang ditemukan di Padukuhan X. Anak usia dini di wilayah tersebut telah terbiasa menggunakan gadget dalam durasi yang cukup lama sehingga memunculkan berbagai permasalahan perilaku dan emosional, seperti tantrum, mudah marah, kesulitan fokus, serta berkurangnya interaksi sosial. Kondisi ini dipengaruhi oleh pola pengasuhan orang tua yang cenderung memberikan gadget sebagai sarana untuk menenangkan anak ketika orang tua sibuk melakukan aktivitas sehari-hari. Kegiatan ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan pemahaman orang tua tentang penggunaan gadget pada anak usia dini melalui psikoedukasi di Padukuhan X. Metode yang digunakan meliputi observasi, wawancara semi terstruktur, Focus Group Discussion (FGD), dan analisis data sekunder. Hasil asesmen menunjukkan bahwa sebagian besar orang tua belum memiliki pemahaman yang memadai mengenai dampak penggunaan gadget secara berlebihan serta pentingnya pendampingan dalam penggunaan gadget pada anak. Setelah pelaksanaan psikoedukasi, orang tua menunjukkan peningkatan pemahaman terkait dampak penggunaan gadget, pembatasan durasi penggunaan, dan pentingnya pendampingan orang tua. Hasil kegiatan ini menunjukkan bahwa psikoedukasi dapat menjadi upaya preventif dalam meningkatkan pemahaman orang tua mengenai penggunaan gadget yang sehat pada anak usia dini. Kata Kunci: Anak usia dini; Gadget; Orang tua; Psikoedukasi; Komunitas

title: Psikoedukasi Regulasi Emosi pada Lansia untuk Meningkatkan Pengetahuan dan Pemahaman Emosional di Kalurahan SS
abstractText: Lansia merupakan kelompok usia yang rentan mengalami permasalahan emosional akibat perubahan fisik, psikologis, dan sosial yang terjadi pada masa penuaan. Berdasarkan hasil wawancara awal dengan kader dan perangkat desa di Kalurahan SS, ditemukan bahwa banyak lansia mengalami kesulitan dalam meregulasi emosi, seperti mudah marah, tersinggung, merasa kesepian, dan menarik diri dari lingkungan sosial. Oleh karena itu, kegiatan pengabdian masyarakat ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan pengetahuan dan pemahaman lansia mengenai regulasi emosi melalui kegiatan psikoedukasi. Kegiatan dilakukan menggunakan desain One Group Pretest–Posttest Design dengan melibatkan 25 lansia yang tergabung dalam kegiatan BKL (Bina Keluarga Lansia). Intervensi dilakukan melalui psikoedukasi, diskusi, kampanye media cetak berupa leaflet, poster, dan banner, serta monitoring dan follow up. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan adanya peningkatan skor pre-test dan post-test pada sebagian besar peserta, yang menunjukkan peningkatan pengetahuan dan pemahaman terkait regulasi emosi. Secara kualitatif, lansia, keluarga, kader, dan masyarakat juga mengaku memperoleh wawasan baru mengenai pengelolaan emosi pada lansia. Meskipun demikian, masih terdapat beberapa kendala, seperti keterbatasan waktu pelaksanaan, partisipasi peserta yang belum optimal, serta belum konsistennya penerapan strategi regulasi emosi dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

title: IQLIM O‘ZGARISHI SHAROITIDA SUV RESURSLARINI BOSHQARISHDA RAQAMLI TEXNOLOGIYALAR
abstractText: Maqolada iqlim o‘zgarishi sharoitida suv resurslarini boshqarishningdolzarb muammolari va ularni yumshatishda raqamli texnologiyalarning imkoniyatlaritahlil qilinadi. IoT sensorlari, masofadan zondlash, geografik axborot tizimlari (GIS),sun’iy intellekt, katta ma’lumotlar va avtomatlashtirilgan sug‘orish yechimlarining suvsarfini hisobga olish, yo‘qotishlarni aniqlash, suv taqsimotini rejalashtirish hamdaqurg‘oqchilik xavfini baholashdagi vazifalari yoritiladi. Tadqiqot adabiyotlar sharhi vaxalqaro tashkilotlar hisobotlarining qiyosiy tahliliga asoslangan. O‘zbekiston sharoitidairrigatsiya infratuzilmasini modernizatsiya qilish, suv hisobini raqamlashtirish,ma’lumotlar almashinuvi va texnik salohiyatni rivojlantirish ustuvor yo‘nalishlar sifatidako‘rsatiladi. Maqolada raqamli yechimlarning samarasi mahalliy sharoit, boshqaruv sifativa ma’lumotlarning ishonchliligiga bog‘liqligi ta’kidlanadi.

title: VOLFRAM SAQLOVCHI TEXNOGEN CHIQINDILARNI BOYITISHDA CHO‘KTIRISH MASHINASI VA VINTLI SEPARATOR SXEMALARINING TEXNOLOGIK SAMARADORLIGINI QIYOSIY BAHOLASH

title: “YASAUL” KONI OMBORIDAN OLINGAN TEXNOLOGIK NAMUNANI TADQIQ QILISH
abstractText: Ushbu maqolada “Auminzo-Amantay” konining “Yasaul” omboridanolingan texnologik namunaning sorbsion sianlash usulida qayta ishlanishi bo‘yichalaboratoriya tadqiqotlari natijalari keltirilgan. Tadqiqotning asosiy maqsadi oltin vakumushning sianlash jarayonida ajralib chiqish darajasiga ma’danni maydalash darajasihamda sorbsion sianlash davomiyligining ta’sirini aniqlashdan iborat. Boshlang‘ichnamunada oltin miqdori 0,70 g/t, kumush miqdori 6,10 g/t ni tashkil etdi. Tajribalar 70,80 va 90 % sinfi -0,071 mm bo‘lgan maydalash darajalarida hamda 24, 30 va 36 soatliksianlash davomiyligida olib borildi. Barcha tajribalarda NaCN konsentratsiyasi 500 mg/lva ko‘mirning bir martalik yuklamasi 3,4 % qilib belgilandi. Tadqiqot natijalariga ko‘ra,maydalash darajasi va sianlash davomiyligining ortishi oltin va kumushning eritmagao‘tish darajasini oshirishi aniqlandi. Eng yuqori natija 90 % sinfi -0,071 mm bo‘lganmaydalash va 36 soatlik sianlash sharoitida olindi. Mazkur rejimda oltinning ajralibchiqishi 72,8 %, kumushniki esa 93,4 % ni tashkil etdi.

title: POLISTIROL CHIQINDILARIDAN OLINGAN STIROL ASOSIDAGI KOMPOZITSION SORBENT YORDAMIDA MOLIBDEN ISHLAB CHIQARISHI TEXNOGEN ERITMALARIDAN RENIYNI AJRATIB OLISH

title: ИНСТИТУЦИОНАЛЬНЫЙ ТИП ВУЗА КАК ФАКТОР ТРАНСФОРМАЦИИ НОРМ ИНТЕРНЕТ-КОММУНИКАЦИИ В ОБРАЗОВАТЕЛЬНОМ ДИСКУРСЕ
abstractText: ИНСТИТУЦИОНАЛЬНЫЙ ТИП ВУЗА КАК ФАКТОР ТРАНСФОРМАЦИИ НОРМ ИНТЕРНЕТ-КОММУНИКАЦИИ В ОБРАЗОВАТЕЛЬНОМ ДИСКУРСЕ Цель исследования – выявить особенности цифровой образовательной коммуникации студентов и преподавателей в зависимости от институционального типа вуза и социокультурных характеристик учебных групп. Материал исследования составили около 500 сообщений из 20 Telegram-чатов Узбекского государственного университета мировых языков и Университета Alfraganus за период с сентября 2025 года по июль 2026 года. Использованы описательный, сопоставительный, контекстуально-прагматический и количественный методы. Установлено, что в государственном вузе чаще используются формализованные обращения и стратегии поддержания академической дистанции, тогда как в частном университете заметнее сочетание официального и разговорного стилей, сокращений, эмодзи и англицизмов. По результатам анкетирования, 93,1 % респондентов назвали Telegram основным средством образовательной коммуникации, а 78,6 % считают соблюдение сетевого этикета обязательным. Сделан вывод о формировании гибридной модели академического общения, объединяющей традиционные нормы и современные цифровые практики. Ключевые слова: цифровая коммуникация, образовательный дискурс, сетевой этикет, академическая дистанция, высшее образование, социокультурные факторы, Telegram. OLIY TA’LIM MUASSASASINING INSTITUTSIONAL TURI TA’LIMIY DISKURSDA INTERNET MULOQOTI ME’YORLARINING O‘ZGARISH OMILI SIFATIDA Tadqiqotning maqsadi oliy ta’lim muassasasining institutsional turi va o‘quv guruhlarining sotsiomadaniy xususiyatlariga qarab talabalar hamda o‘qituvchilarning raqamli ta’limiy muloqotini o‘rganishdan iborat. Tadqiqot materiallarini 2025-yil sentabrdan 2026-yil iyulgacha faoliyat yuritgan O‘zbekiston davlat jahon tillari universiteti va Alfraganus universitetining 20 ta Telegram guruhi hamda 500 ga yaqin xabar tashkil etdi. Tadqiqotda tavsifiy, qiyosiy, kontekstual-pragmatik va miqdoriy metodlardan foydalanildi. Natijalar davlat universiteti guruhlarida rasmiy murojaatlar va akademik masofani saqlash usullari, xususiy universitetda esa rasmiy va so‘zlashuv uslublari uyg‘unligi, qisqartmalar, emojilar va inglizcha o‘zlashmalarning ko‘proq qo‘llanishini ko‘rsatdi. So‘rovnoma natijalariga ko‘ra, respondentlarning 93,1 foizi Telegramni asosiy ta’limiy muloqot vositasi deb hisoblaydi, 78,6 foizi tarmoq odobiga rioya qilishni zarur deb biladi. Raqamli akademik muloqotda an’anaviy me’yorlar va zamonaviy kommunikativ usullar uyg‘unlashayotgani aniqlandi. Kalit so‘zlar: raqamli muloqot, ta’limiy diskurs, tarmoq odobi, akademik masofa, oliy ta’lim, sotsiomadaniy omillar, Telegram. THE INSTITUTIONAL TYPE OF HIGHER EDUCATION INSTITUTION AS A FACTOR IN THE TRANSFORMATION OF INTERNET COMMUNICATION NORMS IN EDUCATIONAL DISCOURSE The study aims to identify the features of digital educational communication between students and teachers in relation to the institutional type of higher education institution and the sociocultural characteristics of academic groups. The empirical material consists of approximately 500 messages from 20 Telegram chats at the Uzbekistan State World Languages University and Alfraganus University, collected between September 2025 and July 2026. Descriptive, comparative, contextual-pragmatic, and quantitative methods were applied. The findings indicate that formal forms of address and strategies for maintaining academic distance are more common in the state university, while the private university demonstrates a greater combination of formal and informal registers, abbreviations, emojis, and English borrowings. According to the survey, 93.1% of respondents identified Telegram as their primary educational communication tool, while 78.6% considered compliance with netiquette essential. The study concludes that a hybrid model of academic communication is emerging, combining traditional norms with contemporary digital practices. Keywords: digital communication, educational discourse, netiquette, academic distance, higher education, sociocultural factors, Telegram.

title: INGLIZ VA O'ZBEK TILLARIDA NUTQ ETIKETINING LINGVOPRAGMATIK VA LINGVOMADANIY XUSUSIYATLARI
abstractText: INGLIZ VA O‘ZBEK TILLARIDA NUTQ ETIKETINING LINGVOPRAGMATIK VA LINGVOMADANIY XUSUSIYATLARI Maqolada ingliz va o‘zbek tillaridagi nutq etiketi birliklarining lingvopragmatik va lingvomadaniy xususiyatlari qiyosiy tahlil qilindi. Murojaat shakllari, salomlashish, iltimos, minnatdorchilik, uzr so‘rash va xayrlashish formulalarining semantik mazmuni bilan bir qatorda ularning ijtimoiy-pragmatik vazifalari o‘rganildi. Tahlil natijalari ingliz tilida xushmuomalalik ko‘pincha modal konstruksiyalar, bilvositalik va yumshatish vositalari orqali, o‘zbek tilida esa “sen/siz” oppozitsiyasi, hurmat shakllari, qarindoshlik asosidagi murojaatlar hamda an’anaviy tilak formulalari orqali ifodalanishini ko‘rsatdi. Leksik ekvivalentlik har doim pragmatik ekvivalentlikni ta’minlamasligi asoslandi. Natijalar qiyosiy tilshunoslik, tarjimashunoslik va ingliz tilini o‘qitishda pragmatik kompetensiyani rivojlantirish uchun ahamiyatlidir. Kalit so‘zlar: nutq etiketi, pragmatika, xushmuomalalik, ingliz tili, o‘zbek tili, nutq akti, murojaat shakllari, pragmatik ekvivalentlik, lingvomadaniyat. LINGUOPRAGMATIC AND LINGUOCULTURAL FEATURES OF SPEECH ETIQUETTE IN ENGLISH AND UZBEK The article presents a comparative linguopragmatic and linguocultural analysis of speech etiquette in English and Uzbek. It examines not only the semantic content of address forms, greetings, requests, gratitude, apologies and leave-taking formulas, but also their social and pragmatic functions. The analysis shows that English commonly encodes politeness through modal constructions, conventional indirectness and mitigation, whereas Uzbek makes extensive use of the sen/siz distinction, honorific forms, kinship-based address terms and culturally established goodwill formulas. The study argues that lexical equivalence does not necessarily produce pragmatic equivalence and identifies several areas of partial correspondence and pragmatic lacunarity. The findings are relevant to contrastive linguistics, translation studies and the development of pragmatic competence in English-language teaching. Keywords: speech etiquette, pragmatics, politeness, English, Uzbek, speech act, address forms, pragmatic equivalence, linguoculture. ЛИНГВОПРАГМАТИЧЕСКИЕ И ЛИНГВОКУЛЬТУРНЫЕ ОСОБЕННОСТИ РЕЧЕВОГО ЭТИКЕТА В АНГЛИЙСКОМ И УЗБЕКСКОМ ЯЗЫКАХ В статье проводится сопоставительный лингвопрагматический и лингвокультурологический анализ речевого этикета в английском и узбекском языках. Рассматриваются не только семантические особенности форм обращения, приветствия, просьбы, благодарности, извинения и прощания, но и их социально-прагматические функции. Анализ показывает, что в английском языке вежливость часто выражается посредством модальных конструкций, конвенциональной косвенности и средств смягчения, тогда как в узбекском языке важную роль играют оппозиция sen/siz, почтительные формы, термины родства в функции обращения и культурно обусловленные формулы благопожелания. Обосновывается положение о том, что лексическая эквивалентность не всегда обеспечивает прагматическую эквивалентность. Результаты исследования могут быть использованы в сопоставительном языкознании, переводоведении и обучении английскому языку. title: Evolutionary genomics of ancient and endangered Achnatherum breviaristatum on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau
abstractText: Climate change and human activities present substantial threats to the biodiversity of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau (QTP), a region renowned for its rich endemic species. We aimed to examine genomic diversity and evolutionary trajectory of Achnatherum breviaristatum, a critically endangered monotypic grass genus endemic to the QTP. Diverging from its sister clade approximately 15 million years ago, A. breviaristatum stands in contrast to two widespread, ecologically dominant monotypic genera within the same clade—Neotrinia splendens and Psammochloa villosa—which thrive in arid northwestern China and neighboring regions. By analyzing high-quality chromosome-level genome assemblies and population resequencing data from all three species, we reveal that A. breviaristatum exhibits markedly low genetic diversity and heterozygosity. All species underwent parallel demographic declines since the Quaternary glaciation. During the Holocene, population sizes of all three species continued to diminish further, with A. breviaristatum ultimately becoming the smallest. The species’ current critically endangered status likely stems from its inability to reproduce clonally compared with two widespread relatives, coupled with Holocene vegetation shift and anthropogenic activities. Intriguingly, a significantly reduced genetic load in A. breviaristatum may have counteracted its low diversity, enabling provisional persistence on the QTP. This study highlights the interplay of historical climatic shifts, genetic constraints, and anthropogenic impacts in shaping the fate of endemic species, offering insights for conservation strategies in vulnerable ecosystems.

title: Complications of Tissue Expander Placement in Reconstructive Surgery
abstractText: Abstract Tissue expanders are widely used in reconstructive surgery, especially for burn patients, breast reconstruction after a mastectomy, or coverage of complex defects. Although they have important advantages in staged reconstruction, they are not without complications. Infection, extrusion, seroma formation, capsular contracture, pain, and implant failure are some of the complications of tissue expander placement as discussed in this paper. Knowledge regarding these risk factors is important for optimizing patient outcomes and creating preventative strategies against complications.

title: Detecting the onset and progression of spinodal decomposition using transient grating spectroscopy
abstractText: Abstract Spinodal decomposition can degrade corrosion resistance and embrittle materials. The ability to quickly, non-destructively detect spinodal decomposition via elastic property measurements before catastrophic materials degradation would represent a significant advance in materials testing. We demonstrate that spinodal decomposition can be detected in a binary Fe-Cr alloy via modulus stiffening using ex situ (and in situ) transient grating spectroscopy (TGS). The modulus stiffening is attributable to the convex dependence of the $$C{\prime}$$ C ′ elastic modulus on chromium content within certain compositional limits, which has been established by prior density functional theory studies. Over this range of initial chromium compositions, chromium partitioning due to spinodal decomposition raises the average $$C{\prime}$$ C ′ modulus such that the decomposed Fe-Cr alloy is stiffer than the initial solid solution. The presence and extent of spinodal decomposition in a 36 at. % chromium alloy are confirmed using atom probe tomography (APT), and are consistent with atomistic simulations that predict elastic modulus stiffening in the same alloy. The observed spinodal decomposition via APT is used to predict an expected modulus stiffening which, based on a simple model, agrees in sign and order of magnitude with the observed stiffening via TGS. The quantitative link between an observed composition change and a measured elastic response suggests TGS as a potential tool for non-destructive evaluation of spinodal decomposition in high-chromium ferritic phases in steels.

title: СУРУНКАЛИ ЮРАК ҚОН-ТОМИР ВА НАФАС ТИЗИМИ КАСАЛЛИКЛАРИ МАВЖУД ТУМАНДА ЯШОВЧИ БЕМОРЛАРНИНГ ДАВОЛАНИШГА МОЙИЛЛИКЛАРИНИ ЎРГАНИШ (Самарқанд вилояти мисолида)

Сурункали касалликларни муваффақиятли бошқариш нафақат самарали тиббий давони, балки беморнинг даволаниш жараёнида фаол иштирокини ҳам талаб қилади. title: All-heavy tetraquarks with different flavors
abstractText: Abstract In a nonrelativistic potential quark model framework, we carry out a precise calculation of the mass spectrum of the all-heavy tetraquarks with different flavors, $bb\bar{b}\bar{c}$, $cc\bar{c}\bar{b}$, $bb\bar{c}\bar{c}$, and $bc\bar{b}\bar{c}$, by adopting the explicitly correlated Gaussian method. A complete mass spectrum for the $1S$ states is obtained. For the $bb\bar{b}\bar{c}$, $cc\bar{c}\bar{b}$, $bb\bar{c}\bar{c}$, and $bc\bar{b}\bar{c}$ systems, the $1S$ states are predicted to lie in the mass ranges of $ \sim(16.06,16.14)$, $\sim(9.65,9.74)$, $\sim(12.89,12.94)$, and $\sim(12.75,12.99)$~GeV, respectively. Moreover, by using the obtained masses and wave functions, we evaluate the fall-apart decay properties within a quark-exchange model. The results show that the $1S$ states of the all-heavy tetraquarks with different flavors may have narrow fall-apart decay widths, which range from a few tenths to several MeV. Some all-heavy tetraquarks with different flavors could be search for at LHC in their optimal fall-apart decay channels, such as $\Upsilon J/\psi$, $\Upsilon B_c^-$, and $J/\psi B_c^+$.

title: Volumetric dilution nasal spray as a harm reduction strategy for intranasal psychoactive substance use: a practical framework and rationale
abstractText: Abstract Background Intranasal insufflation of psychoactive substances, including cocaine, MDMA, and ketamine, is associated with a well-documented spectrum of nasal and sinonasal complications. These result from at least three distinct but interacting mechanisms: mechanical trauma from particulate matter, vasoconstriction-induced mucosal ischaemia (primarily relevant for cocaine), and chemical irritation from adulterants. Harm reduction (HR) programmes have traditionally focused on hygiene, shared equipment, and product testing, but the form of the substance itself, solid powder versus aqueous solution, has received little formal attention. Main body Volumetric dilution nasal spray (VDNS) is an approach in which the substance is dissolved in sterile saline and delivered via a calibrated spray device. This method eliminates mechanical mucosal trauma from powder particles, delivers the substance in a hydrated vehicle compatible with mucosal physiology, and converts an uncontrolled line-based dosing practice into a quantifiable per-spray unit. Drawing on pharmaceutical nasal delivery science, existing HR resources from community organisations, and field feedback from harm reduction professionals, this article describes the rationale, practical implementation, limitations, and field integration of this approach for cocaine, MDMA, and ketamine. The method is grounded in the pharmacokinetics of intranasal absorption, the known pathophysiology of snorting-related nasal damage, and the principles of non-normative harm reduction. Conclusion VDNS represents a low-barrier, low-cost HR intervention that is coherent with existing national and international HR frameworks. Formal evaluation of its acceptability and impact on nasal morbidity is needed. Pending such data, its dissemination by HR professionals in community settings is supported by biological plausibility and field practice.

title: Anomalous Reversal of CO2-Induced Viscosity/Diffusivity Trends in Water: A Molecular Dynamics Study
abstractText: Abstract Experimental viscosity data for dilute, water-rich aqueous CO2 are available only up to moderate temperatures, with reported measurements up to 449 K, leaving the temperature regime relevant to geothermal and carbon capture, utilization, and storage (CCUS) applications largely unexplored. Here, equilibrium molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were used to compute viscosity, self-diffusion coefficients, and density of CO2–H2O mixtures over 278–900 K and 10–30 MPa using multiple combinations of force fields for water and CO2. At 278–443 K, increasing the CO2 fraction increased viscosity and decreased molecular mobility, consistent with available low-temperature measurements. At 573 K, however, the trend reversed: at xCO2 = 5 mol %, the viscosity decreased by about 10% relative to pure water at 25 MPa, whereas the diffusivity increased by about 8% at 20 MPa. Above 700 K, composition effects became weaker and often comparable to the associated uncertainties. Analyses of number density, CO2 hydration, hydrogen bonding, tetrahedral order, and rotational relaxation show that the reversal behavior originates from the temperature-dependent volumetric and structural response of the water network to CO2 dissolution. The results identify a transport anomaly near 573 K that should be considered in modeling water-rich CO2-bearing fluids.

title: Developmental restriction of the jaw skeletal muscle cardiogenic potential
abstractText: Cardiovascular diseases are a leading cause of mortality worldwide and heart failure remains an end-stage disease with no other treatment than transplantation. A promising field to tackle heart failure is regenerative medicine. Whereas cardiomyocyte generation in large numbers from pluripotent or reprogrammed stem cells has shown promising results, direct derivation of cardiomyocytes from somatic stem cells is still challenging. Skeletal muscle progenitors have been extensively studied as a source of cardiac cells, due to their cellular and functional similarities. During development, the right ventricular myocardium and jaw skeletal muscles derive from a common pool of myogenic mesodermal progenitors. Previous studies have reported the derivation of cardiomyocyte-like cells specifically from adult mouse jaw muscle stem cell populations, but not from other skeletal muscles, suggesting that their developmental origin endows jaw muscle cells cardiogenic potential. In the present study, we evaluated the cardiogenic potential of satellite cells and mesenchymal progenitor cells from the masticatory muscle by reproducing, optimizing and diversifying previously described protocols. We consistently found that stem cells from masticatory muscles are unable to differentiate into cardiac cells under any tested cardiogenic environment. Furthermore, the addition of various small molecule inhibitors that reprogram repressive epigenetic marks reaped the same success, suggesting that epigenetic barriers restraining lineage plasticity are profound and unlikely to be reversed by simple exposure to cardiogenic environments.

title: Biaxiality-Controlled Crystallization Dictates Multiaxial Fracture in Elastomers
abstractText: Abstract Fracture in elastomers is commonly described by a critical energy release rate determined under uniaxial loading, yet its applicability to multiaxial deformation and microstructurally evolving materials remains unclear. Here, we quantify crack-growth onset in elastomer sheets under controlled biaxial stretching by combining energetic analysis with high-resolution measurements of near-tip deformation fields. For predominantly elastic elastomers, crack initiation occurs at a material-specific critical energy release rate that is insensitive to deformation biaxiality. In contrast, strain-induced crystallizing elastomers such as natural rubber exhibit a breakdown of this universality driven by a biaxiality-controlled transition in near-tip fields. Below a critical deformation state, crystallization remains spatially confined, with minimal impact on crack resistance. Above this threshold, crystallization expands across a larger region around the crack tip, significantly elevating the crack-opening displacement and the critical energy release rate. Consequently, fracture resistance is governed by the size and development of the crystallized zone rather than an intrinsic constant. These results delineate when elastomer fracture follows universal energetic laws versus deformation-activated structural transformations. This framework provides practical guidance for designing robust elastomers for complex loading in tires, soft robots, and biomedical devices.

title: Persistent influx of atmospheric microplastics and nanoplastics to Mount Everest driven by large scale circulation
abstractText: This dataset contains the source data supporting the study “Persistent Influx of Atmospheric Microplastics and Nanoplastics to Mount Everest Driven by Large Scale Circulation.” It includes the underlying microplastic, nanoplastic, and meteorological datasets used in the analyses, together with source files for the main figures (Figures 1–4) and spatial/trajectory datasets associated with Figures 4, S9, and S10.
