title: სამედიცინო მომსახურება საბჭოთა გულაგში: სახელმწიფო კონტროლი, დასჯა და ადამიანური სოლიდარობა
abstractText: Abstract. This paper examines the medical system of the "Gulag" (Chief Administration of Camps) as an integral part of the Soviet repressive apparatus. The objective of this study is to determine how medical care, in alignment with ideological and economic requirements, became a tool for the exploitation and control of human resources. The paper analyzes the medical infrastructure of the Gulag and contrasts it with the actual health status of the prisoners. The study employs a historical-comparative method, utilizing both archival data and the memoir literature of survivors (e.g., V. Shalamov, E. Ginzburg, and others). The research demonstrates that the formal structure of the medical system often masked systemic dehumanization, while the efforts of prisoner-physicians to maintain professional ethics represented a rare but significant form of resistance. The findings confirm that violations of medical ethics in the Gulag were not the result of individual moral failures, but rather the inevitable consequence of an ethical infrastructure deliberately dismantled by the state.

title: A combinatorial genetics approach reveals limits to redundancy within Plasmodium falciparum invasion ligand families
abstractText: Abstract To maintain infection in the human bloodstream, Plasmodium falciparum parasites undergo repeated cycles of invasion of and multiplication inside red blood cells (RBCs). Two protein families, the Erythrocyte binding-like (EBA) and Reticulocyte binding-like (Rh) proteins, are known to play a key role in invasion, mediating early stages of attachment of the P. falciparum merozoite to the host RBC. There is a degree of redundancy within these families, such that disrupting the function of individual EBA/Rh proteins in vitro is not sufficient to prevent invasion. By employing a novel approach to disrupt multiple EBA and Rh genes in combination, we systematically assess functional interdependency across these families for the first time. This analysis, and further characterisation of mutant parasites, reveals that disruption of some pairs of EBA/Rh ligands significantly impacts P. falciparum invasion, whereas others do not. Disruption of PfEBA175 in combination with either PfRh2b or PfRh4 significantly reduces parasite multiplication in vitro, indicating that the remaining EBA/Rh proteins cannot fully compensate for the absence of these three key invasion ligands. PfEBA175, PfRh2b and PfRh4 may therefore represent a critical nexus of the parasite invasion machinery, and combinatorial approaches that target these specific ligands could be a beneficial therapeutic approach.

title: PENGARUH STOCK OPNAME TERHADAP AKURASI DAN KEANDALAN LAPORAN PERSEDIAAN PADA UMKM DESSERT KABUPATEN KENDAL
abstractText: The problem that is often experienced by UMKM is the Differences between actual stock and existing records are often caused by errors in data entry, lost goods, or lack of inventory control. This study aims to determine the effect of stocktaking on the accuracy and reliability of inventory reports in dessert UMKM in Kendal Regency. This study uses a quantitative method with data collection techniques through distributing questionnaires to 30 respondents consisting of owners or managers of dessert UMKM in Kendal Regency. The information used in this study was processed with the help of the "Statistical Package for the Social Sciences" (SPSS) software, through Validity Tests and Hypothesis Tests. The results show that most items in the stocktaking, accuracy, and reliability variables are declared valid and suitable for use as research instruments. The implementation of stocktaking that is carried out routinely can help UMKM in reducing inventory recording errors, minimizing stock differences, and increasing the accuracy and reliability of inventory reports. Thus, the implementation of stocktaking has an important role in supporting inventory management in dessert UMKM in Kendal Regency.

title: PENGARUH LINGKUNGAN KERJA & WORK-LIFE BALANCE TERHADAP TURNOVER INTENTION MELALUI KEPUASAN KERJA SEBAGAI VARIABEL INTERVENING: STUDI PADA KARYAWAN GENERASI Z DI KECAMATAN KEMBANGAN
abstractText: Generation Z tends to have shorter working hours than previous generations and places a supportive work environment, work-life balance, and well-being as the main considerations in determining career sustainability. Turnover intention in Generation Z employees is a challenge for organizations because it has the potential to affect the stability of human resources and organizational effectiveness. This study is needed with the aim of analyzing the influence of the work environment and work-life balance on turnover intention through job satisfaction as an intervening variable in Generation Z employees. Primary data was obtained through questionnaire deployment and analyzed using the PLS-SEM method with the help of SmartPLS version 4.1.1.8. The results of the study show that the work environment and work-life balance have a positive and significant effect on job satisfaction. In addition, only the work environment has been shown to have a positive and significant effect on turnover intention, while work-life balance and job satisfaction have no significant effect on turnover intention. The findings of the study confirm that job satisfaction has not played a role as an intervening variable in the relationship between the work environment and work-life balance and turnover intention. Simultaneously, work environment, work-life balance, and job satisfaction have a significant effect on turnover intention.

title: MEMBANGUN LOYALITAS PENGGUNA SHOPEEPAY: PERAN KEMUDAHAN, MANFAAT DAN KEPERCAYAAN DALAM PENGGUNAAN SHOPEEPAY
abstractText: Adoption of digital wallets has made user loyalty an important aspect for service providers. This study aims to examine the effects of Perceived Usefulness and Perceived Ease of Use on ShopeePay User Loyalty, with Trust serving as a mediating variable among university students in Semarang City. This study employed a quantitative approach with an explanatory research design through an online survey using a purposive sampling technique involving 171 respondents. Data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares–Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS 4 software. The results indicate that Perceived Usefulness has a positive and significant effect on both Trust and User Loyalty, whereas Perceived Ease of Use has a positive and significant effect only on Trust. Furthermore, Trust has a positive and significant effect on User Loyalty and acts as a full mediator in the relationship between Perceived Ease of Use and User Loyalty, while serving as a partial mediator in the relationship between Perceived Usefulness and User Loyalty. These findings highlight that Trust plays a crucial role in strengthening ShopeePay user loyalty, while perceived usefulness enhances loyalty both directly and indirectly through trust.

title: PENGARUH CURRENT RATIO, PRICE TO BOOK VALUE DAN RETURN ON ASSET TERHADAP RETURN SAHAM
abstractText: This study aims to analyze the effect of Current Ratio (CR), Price to Book Value (PBV), and Return on Assets (ROA) on stock returns in telecommunication sub-sector companies listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX). The background of this study is based on fluctuations in companies' financial performance, which are assumed to influence the level of returns obtained by investors. The research method used is quantitative with an associative approach. The population consists of 22 telecommunication sub-sector companies, with a sample of 3 companies selected using purposive sampling technique. The research data includes 18 observations during the period 2019–2024. Data analysis was conducted using multiple linear regression with the help of SPSS version 26, including classical assumption tests, regression analysis, coefficient of determination test, t-test, and F-test. The results show that partially, CR and ROA have no significant effect on stock returns, with significance values of 0.506 and 0.316, respectively. Meanwhile, PBV has a significant effect on stock returns with a significance value of 0.044. Simultaneously, CR, PBV, and ROA do not have a significant effect on stock returns (Sig. 0.144). The coefficient of determination (R²) is 0.312, indicating that 31.2% of stock return variation can be explained by the model, while 68.8% is influenced by other factors outside the research model.

title: PENGARUH PEMASARAN DIGITAL DAN BRAND AWARENESS TERHADAP PURCHASE INTENTION PADA TIKTOK
abstractText: This study aims to analyze the influence of Digital Marketing and Brand Awareness on Purchase Intention among TikTok users in Tuban Regency, both partially and simultaneously. A quantitative approach was employed through a survey of 100 active TikTok users aged 17–35 years, selected using a non-probability sampling technique. The research instrument was a questionnaire, which was tested for validity and reliability before the data were analyzed using classical assumption tests and multiple linear regression with IBM SPSS Statistics. The findings demonstrate that Digital Marketing has a positive and significant partial effect on Purchase Intention (t = 4.475; Sig. < 0.001). Similarly, Brand Awareness has a positive and significant partial effect on Purchase Intention (t = 6.135; Sig. < 0.001), with a more dominant contribution than Digital Marketing. Furthermore, both variables simultaneously have a significant effect on Purchase Intention (F = 95.496; Sig. < 0.001), explaining 65.6% of the variation in Purchase Intention (Adjusted R Square = 0.656). These findings may serve as a reference for business practitioners in developing more effective and optimal digital marketing strategies on the TikTok platform

title: THE INFLUENCE OF FINANCIAL TECHNOLOGY, RISK TOLERANCE, FINANCIAL SELF-EFFICACY, COGNITIVE DISSONANCE BIAS, AND LOSS AVERSION ON INVESTMENT DECISIONS
abstractText: Investment decisions are shaped by various investor considerations, including financial technology, risk tolerance, financial self-efficacy, cognitive dissonance bias, and loss aversion. Because the findings of previous studies have been inconsistent, this study re-examines the effect of these five variables on investment decisions. Data were collected quantitatively from 100 respondents in Wonosobo Regency, with the sample size determined using the Slovin formula, and analyzed using multiple linear regression. The simultaneous test shows that all independent variables have a significant effect on investment decisions. However, the partial test shows that only financial self-efficacy and cognitive dissonance bias are significant, indicating that investors take these two factors into account when investing. Meanwhile, financial technology, risk tolerance, and loss aversion show no significant effect

title: GREEN PERCEIVED QUALITY DAN GREEN PERCEIVED CONSUMERISM SEBAGAI DETERMINAN GREEN PURCHASE INTENTION: ANALISIS PADA UMKM BERBASIS GREEN ECONOMY
abstractText: This study aims to examine the influence of green perceived quality and green perceived consumerism on green purchase intention, with green perceived value acting as a mediating variable, regarding green products produced by MSMEs. The study involved 100 respondents, purchasers of green products at food retailers in Central Java, selected using purposive sampling. Primary data were collected via a questionnaire using a 1–5 Likert scale and subsequently analyzed using the Structural Equation Modeling-Partial Least Squares (SEM-PLS) method with SmartPLS software (version 4.1.1.8). The results indicate that green perceived quality, green perceived consumerism, and green perceived value significantly influence green purchase intention. Regarding the mediating role, green perceived value was found to mediate the effects of green perceived quality and green perceived consumerism on green purchase intention. Furthermore, the results demonstrate that green perceived value mediates the influence of green brand image on green purchase intention, confirming the role of this intervening variable in the relationship.

title: PENGARUH SARANA PRASARANA DAN LINGKUNGAN KERJA TERHADAP KINERJA GURU SMA NEGERI 1 BATUKLIANG UTARA DI KABUPATEN LOMBOK TENGAH
abstractText: Teacher performance is a key determinant of educational quality and the successful implementation of learning processes. Among the factors that may influence teacher performance are the adequacy of educational facilities and infrastructure, as well as the quality of the working environment. This study aims to examine the influence of facilities and infrastructure, together with the work environment, on teacher performance at SMA Negeri 1 Batukliang Utara, Central Lombok Regency. A quantitative approach with a descriptive research design was employed. The study involved all 33 active teachers using a total sampling technique. Data were collected through a structured questionnaire based on a five-point Likert scale and analyzed using multiple linear regression with IBM SPSS Statistics version 26. The findings reveal that facilities and infrastructure do not have a significant partial effect on teacher performance (β = 0.017; p = 0.933), whereas the work environment has a positive and statistically significant effect (β = 0.770; p = 0.003). Simultaneously, both independent variables significantly influence teacher performance (F = 10.840; p < 0.001), explaining 41.9% of the variance in teacher performance, while the remaining 58.1% is attributable to other factors not included in the research model. These findings indicate that a supportive and conducive work environment plays a more substantial role than educational facilities in improving teacher performance. Therefore, school management should prioritize the creation of a positive work environment while continuing to improve educational facilities to support teachers' professional responsibilities.

title: STRATEGIC HRM DAN KINERJA ORGANISASI: MEDIASI ENGAGEMENT DAN KOMITMEN
abstractText: This conceptual article develops an integrative framework explaining how Strategic Human Resource Management (SHRM) can improve organizational performance through employee engagement and organizational commitment. In response to the need for a theoretically grounded explanation of the HRM-performance 'black box', the article synthesizes recent literature on strategic fit, job resources, social exchange, employee engagement, organizational commitment, and organizational performance. The synthesis positions employee engagement as a motivational mechanism that converts HR practices into work energy, dedication, and discretionary effort, while organizational commitment is positioned as a relational mechanism that converts perceived organizational investment into attachment, loyalty, and sustained contribution. The proposed model includes direct pathways from SHRM to performance, engagement, and commitment; pathways from engagement to commitment and performance; and a serial mechanism of SHRM -> engagement -> commitment -> organizational performance. The article contributes by integrating motivational and relational mechanisms in one conceptual architecture and by translating the model into managerial implications for HR architecture, line-manager implementation, employee experience, and performance-pathway evaluation. The framework is intended for subsequent empirical testing using field data, preferably with longitudinal or multi-wave and multi-source designs.

title: PENGARUH DISIPLIN KERJA DAN LINGKUNGAN KERJA TERHADAP KINERJA KARYAWAN PADA PERUSAHAAN GARMEN DI SEMARANG
abstractText: This study empirically examines the contribution of work discipline and the workplace environment toward employee performance within the garment industry in Semarang. Employing a quantitative approach, primary data was gathered from 100 respondents via structured questionnaires. The data processing was conducted using IBM SPSS Statistics, encompassing assessments of data quality (validity and reliability) alongside classical assumption testing (normality, heteroscedasticity, and multicollinearity). Furthermore, inter-variable relationships were calculated through multiple linear regression, supplemented by t-tests, F-tests, and coefficient of determination analysis to measure the model's capacity to explain variations in workforce performance. The findings reveal that work discipline plays a vital role and significantly impacts individual performance. Similarly, the work environment variable consistently demonstrates a significant positive contribution. When evaluated simultaneously, the integration of discipline and working conditions exerts a tangible collective influence on overall worker effectiveness. These insights highlight the vital responsibility of management in sustaining employee discipline and fostering a supportive workplace atmosphere to continuously enhance organizational productivity and human well-being.

title: SELF CONTROL MEMODERASI FOMO DAN DOOM SPENDING TERHADAP PERILAKU KEUANGAN
abstractText: This study investigates the effects of fear of missing out (FoMO) and doom spending on financial management behavior, examining self-control as a moderating variable among digital natives in Semarang Regency. Utilizing a quantitative design with purposive sampling, data were gathered from 203 respondents aged 15–45 years using a 1–5 Likert scale and evaluated via Moderated Regression Analysis (MRA) in SmartPLS. The empirical findings reveal that FoMO exerts a significant positive effect on financial management behavior, suggesting that FoMO within this demographic manifests predominantly as a social rather than consumptive drive. In contrast, doom spending demonstrates no statistically significant impact on financial management behavior. Self-control exhibits a substantial positive influence, emerging as the most prominent determinant of sound financial habits. Moreover, self-control significantly moderates specifically attenuating the detrimental effect of doom spending on financial management behavior, yet it fails to moderate the impact of FoMO. With the structural model exhibiting robust predictive relevance, this study highlights the necessity of fostering self-control through financial literacy programs and emotional regulation initiatives to optimize financial behaviors among digital natives.

title: KEKUATAN KONTEN DAN ULASAN DALAM MEMPENGARUHI KEPUTUSAN PEMBELIAN PRODUK MYKONOS KOTA SEMARANG
abstractText: The rapid growth of TikTok as a social media platform has influenced consumer behavior in seeking information and making purchase decisions. This study aims to analyze the effects of User Generated Content (UGC), Electronic Word of Mouth (E-WOM), reviews, and product quality on the purchase decisions of Mykonos perfume consumers in Semarang City. This research employed a quantitative approach using a survey method involving 115 respondents who met the research criteria. Data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares (PLS) with SmartPLS 4 software. The results indicate that E-WOM, product quality, and UGC have a positive and significant effect on purchase decisions, while reviews do not have a significant effect. E-WOM was found to be the most dominant factor influencing consumer purchase decisions. The R-Square value of 0.942 indicates that the research model has a very strong ability to explain purchase decisions. These findings suggest that purchase decisions for Mykonos perfume on TikTok are influenced more by user interactions, user-generated content, and product quality than by product reviews

title: ANALISIS STRATEGI MANAJEMEN OPERASIONAL PADA RUAS JALAN TOL SEMARANG – BATANG DALAM MENINGKATKAN KEPUASAN PENGGUNA
abstractText: The Semarang–Batang segment of the Trans-Java Toll Road serves as a vital artery for social mobility and regional economic distribution in Central Java. However, rising traffic volumes often introduce operational bottlenecks that can compromise commuters' comfort and peace of mind. This study aims to evaluate how operational management strategies can be optimized to elevate service quality and foster genuine commuter satisfaction. Adopting a descriptive quantitative approach, this research gathered empirical survey data from 100 active toll road users. The collected data were systematically analyzed through multiple linear regression techniques using SPSS 26. The statistical outcomes demonstrate that all operational strategy dimensions exert a positive and significant influence on public satisfaction. Individually, traffic management emerged as the most dominant catalyst in alleviating congestion (t = 6.375), followed by infrastructure and facility maintenance (t = 5.222), and information system reliability ($t = 2.086$). Collectively, these three elements explain a substantial 98.6% of the variance in user satisfaction. Discussion: These insights underscore that commuter satisfaction transcends mere metrics; it reflects the fulfillment of fundamental human needs for safety, time-efficiency, and respect. To sustain this trust, operators must prioritize human-centric improvements, such as swiftly patching damaged pavements, optimizing rest area hygiene, and deploying responsive help buttons at toll booths to ensure a dignified and smooth travel experience.

title: Penerapan Komunikasi Interpersonal Guru dan Murid untuk Mendorong Rasa Percaya Diri Anak Usia Dini di TK Mutia Aceh Tamiang
abstractText: Komunikasi interpersonal guru dan murid merupakan aspek penting dalam mendukung perkembangan rasa percaya diri anak usia dini di lingkungan pendidikan. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan pola komunikasi interpersonal guru dan murid dalam meningkatkan rasa percaya diri anak serta mengidentifikasi tantangan yang dihadapi guru selama proses pembelajaran di TK Mutia Aceh Tamiang. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif dengan jenis deskriptif. Informan berjumlah enam orang, terdiri atas dua guru, dua wali murid, dan dua anak didik yang dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi, wawancara mendalam, dan dokumentasi, kemudian dianalisis melalui reduksi data, penyajian data, serta penarikan kesimpulan dan verifikasi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa komunikasi interpersonal dilakukan melalui komunikasi verbal dan nonverbal, perhatian individual, pemberian motivasi, serta penguatan positif berupa pujian dan penghargaan. Pendekatan tersebut memberikan kesempatan kepada anak untuk bercerita, menjawab pertanyaan, berinteraksi, dan tampil di depan kelas secara bertahap. Tantangan yang dihadapi guru meliputi perbedaan karakter, kemampuan komunikasi, serta perubahan kondisi emosional dan konsentrasi anak. Penelitian ini menyimpulkan bahwa komunikasi yang hangat, suportif, dan sesuai dengan kebutuhan anak dapat mendukung perkembangan rasa percaya diri melalui interaksi pembelajaran yang berkelanjutan.

title: Pendidikan Pengolahan Limbah Rumah Tangga menjadi Pupuk Cair bagi Siswa SDN 04 Kota Bengkulu
abstractText: Limbah organik rumah tangga seperti sisa sayuran, kulit buah, dan air cucian beras masih sering dibuang tanpa dimanfaatkan sehingga berpotensi mencemari lingkungan, padahal dapat diolah menjadi pupuk organik cair (POC). Kegiatan pengabdian oleh mahasiswa KKN Kelompok 23 Universitas Muhammadiyah Bengkulu di Kelurahan Pondok Besi ini bertujuan memberikan edukasi pengolahan limbah rumah tangga menjadi pupuk cair bagi siswa SDN 04 Kota Bengkulu. Kegiatan dilaksanakan dalam satu hari melalui tiga tahap yang masing-masing berdurasi satu jam, yaitu penyuluhan dan sosialisasi, demonstrasi pembuatan pupuk cair, serta praktik langsung berkelompok yang dilanjutkan evaluasi, dengan metode ceramah interaktif, demonstrasi, dan praktik langsung (learning by doing). Bahan yang digunakan berupa sisa sayuran, kulit buah, dan air cucian beras yang difermentasi dengan larutan gula dan EM4. Berdasarkan pengamatan dan sesi evaluasi, siswa antusias, aktif bertanya, terlibat langsung dalam praktik, dan tampak memahami jenis limbah rumah tangga serta manfaat pupuk cair. Kegiatan ini diharapkan menumbuhkan kesadaran lingkungan sejak usia dini dan dapat dilanjutkan dengan evaluasi yang terukur serta pemantauan hasil fermentasi di sekolah.

title: The Telecommunications Sector in Yemen: A Quantitative Field Study Using Structural Modeling
abstractText: هدفت هذه الدراسة إلى استكشاف أثر الثقافة التنظيمية في تطبيق مبادئ إدارة الجودة الشاملة في قطاع الاتصالات في اليمن، مع التركيز على أبعاد الثقافة التنظيمية في تطبيق مبادئ إدارة الجودة الشاملة. وقد شملت الدراسة عينة عشوائية طبقية مكونة من (351) موظفًا من خمس شركات رئيسية في قطاع الاتصالات، وهي المؤسسة العامة للاتصالات، شركة يمن موبايل، شركة تليمن للاتصالات الدولية، شركة يو للاتصالات، وشركة سبأفون. استخدمت الدراسة المنهج الوصفي التحليلي، وجُمعت البيانات من خلال استبانة مقيّمة على متغيرين: الثقافة التنظيمية، وإدارة الجودة الشاملة. واستخدمت الدراسة برامج الإحصائية (SPSS، ALAMOS) للتحليل وأظهرت النتائج أن مستوى مرتفع نسبيا للثقافة التنظيمية في شركات قطاع الاتصالات بلغ 74%، بينما كان مستوى متوسط نسبيا في تطبيق مبادئ الجودة الشاملة بنسبة 72%، وكان حجم الأثر بين الثقافة التنظيمية ومبادئ إدارة الجودة الشاملة فعال بمقدار (r = 0.95) ومعامل المسار (p = 0.72). وأكدت النتائج أن أبعاد الثقافة التنظيمية تلعب دورًا فاعلاً بمقدار (f = 1.7) في تعزيز تطبيق مبادئ إدارة الجودة الشاملة. وقد أوصت الدراسة بضرورة تعزيز الثقافة التنظيمية عبر برامج تدريبية مستمرة، بالإضافة إلى تطوير الثقافة التنظيمية الداعمة التي ترتكز على القيم والمعتقدات والسلوكيات الإيجابية، وذلك لتحقيق بيئة عمل محفزة على الابتكار والتحسين المستمر. كما دعت الدراسة إلى تعزيز التواصل الداخلي وتمكين فرق العمل وتطوير أنظمة تقييم الأداء المرتبطة بالجودة والثقافة القيادية. تساهم هذه الدراسة في إثراء المعرفة البحثية حول العلاقة بين الثقافة التنظيمية وإدارة الجودة الشاملة، وتفتح آفاقًا لدراسات مستقبلية تستكشف وسائل وطرق أخرى وعوامل مؤثرة ثقافية في تطبيق الجودة داخل بيئات العمل المختلفة.

title: The impact of IFRS’ application of IFRS on the reduction and impact of profit management practices on information content of the profits: a standard analytical study using the Panel data for industrial companies listed on Iraq Stock Exchange (2019-2023)
abstractText: هدفت هذه الدراسة إلى تحليل أثر تطبيق معايير الإبلاغ المالي الدولية (IFRS) في الحد من ممارسات إدارة الأرباح وانعكاسه على المحتوى المعلوماتي للأرباح في الشركات الصناعية المدرجة في سوق العراق للأوراق المالية، مع اختبار الدور الوسيط لإدارة الأرباح في العلاقة بين تطبيق معايير الإبلاغ المالي الدولية والمحتوى المعلوماتي للأرباح. واعتمدت الدراسة المنهج التحليلي القياسي باستخدام بيانات البانل (Panel Data) لعينة مكونة من خمس شركات صناعية مدرجة في سوق العراق للأوراق المالية خلال الفترة (2019-2023)، وبواقع (25) مشاهدة. ولتحقيق أهداف الدراسة تم بناء نماذج انحدار قياسية لاختبار العلاقات المباشرة وغير المباشرة بين متغيرات الدراسة، مع تضمين عدد من المتغيرات الضابطة المتمثلة بحجم الشركة والرفع المالي ونمو المبيعات. أظهرت النتائج وجود أثر سلبي معنوي لتطبيق معايير الإبلاغ المالي الدولية في ممارسات إدارة الأرباح، إذ بلغ معامل الانحدار (β=-0.314, p=0.002)، مما يدل على أن تطبيق هذه المعايير يسهم في الحد من الممارسات الانتهازية للإدارة. كما أظهرت النتائج وجود تأثير سلبي معنوي لممارسات إدارة الأرباح في المحتوى المعلوماتي للأرباح، إذ بلغ معامل الانحدار (β=-0.391, p=0.001)، بما يشير إلى أن زيادة ممارسات إدارة الأرباح تؤدي إلى انخفاض جودة المعلومات المحاسبية. كذلك بينت النتائج وجود تأثير إيجابي معنوي لتطبيق معايير الإبلاغ المالي الدولية في المحتوى المعلوماتي للأرباح، إذ بلغ معامل الانحدار (β=0.389, p=0.001). كما أكدت نتائج تحليل الوساطة وجود دور وساطة جزئية لإدارة الأرباح في العلاقة بين تطبيق معايير الإبلاغ المالي الدولية والمحتوى المعلوماتي للأرباح.

title: MIKROPLASTIK PADA KONTINUM AIR TAWAR–ESTUARI–PESISIR: PENYIMPANAN TERSEMBUNYI, REMOBILISASI, DAN RISIKO EKOLOGIS
abstractText: Mikroplastik umumnya dipandang sebagai partikel yang terangkut dari daratan melalui sungai dan estuari menuju laut, tetapi pandangan seperti sabuk konveyor ini meremehkan pentingnya penyimpanan di dalam sedimen, dataran banjir, waduk, zona hiporeik, lahan basah pasang surut, maksimum kekeruhan estuari, habitat bervegetasi, dan endapan pesisir dangkal. Tinjauan naratif ini mensintesis bukti terbaru mengenai “penyerap tersembunyi” tersebut dan berargumen bahwa sebagian besar bukan merupakan tempat penyimpanan terminal, melainkan kompartemen penyimpanan dinamis yang signifikansi ekologisnya bergantung pada waktu retensi, transformasi partikel, probabilitas remobilisasi, dan tumpang tindih dengan aktivitas biologis. Di sistem air tawar, hidromorfologi, bendungan, sedimen halus, vegetasi, dan pertukaran hiporeik menciptakan retensi selektif, sedangkan banjir dan operasi pengelolaan sedimen dapat membalik perilaku penyerap. Estuari berfungsi sebagai penyaring semipermeabel tempat pasang surut, gradien salinitas, bahan partikulat tersuspensi, agregasi, dan biofouling berulang kali memindahkan partikel antara air dan sedimen dasar. Teluk pesisir, mangrove, rawa asin, padang lamun, dan sedimen dekat pantai selanjutnya mendistribusikan ulang, bukan sekadar mengakhiri, perjalanan mikroplastik yang dibawa sungai. Pengukuran terbaru menunjukkan bahwa penyimpanan dapat sangat besar, tetapi juga mengungkap bias metodologis akibat ukuran mata jaring, kedalaman pengambilan sampel, batas ukuran partikel, identifikasi polimer, dan konversi antara jumlah partikel dan massa. Karena itu, risiko ekologis terlepas dari kelimpahan sesaat di kolom air: paparan bentik, penuaan partikel, interaksi kokontaminan, perkembangan plastisfer, bioturbasi, dan transfer trofik dapat meningkatkan risiko di zona deposisional berfluks rendah. Kami mengusulkan kerangka penyimpanan–reaktivasi–paparan yang membedakan hotspot transportasi dari hotspot paparan dan memperlakukan penyerap tersembunyi sebagai reservoir yang bergantung pada keadaan. Pemantauan masa depan perlu menggabungkan inventaris teresolusi kedalaman, pengambilan sampel berbasis kejadian, kronologi sedimen, pengukuran hidrodinamika, analisis teresolusi polimer, dan ambang efek yang relevan secara biologis untuk meningkatkan neraca sumber-ke-laut dan penilaian risiko.

Shema Israel
abstractText: This study examines Deuteronomy 6:4–9 using an exegetical-theological approach to identify the bibliological implications embedded in the Shema Israel. While the Shema is often understood as Israel’s confession of faith or as a foundation for moral and religious education, this research demonstrates that the passage also offers an early framework for understanding the nature of God’s Word within Old Testament bibliology. A literary analysis of key terms shema, ahav, lev, and shanan along with the structure of the text, reveals four major themes: authority, internalization, transmission, and praxis of the Word. Yahweh’s identity as the one true God establishes the authority of Scripture; the command to love God requires deep internalization within the heart, mind, and will; the call to teach children highlights a holistic model of transmission; and the symbols on the hand, forehead, and doorposts emphasize the lived practice of the Word. Thus, the Shema presents a comprehensive vision of receiving, embodying, and practicing God’s Word.

L'accent cleaning par l'intelligence artificielle: Enjeux éthiques, responsabilité épistémique et reproduction des hiérarchies linguistiques dans les technologies vocales
abstractText: The widespread deployment of artificial intelligence–based speech technologies is profoundly reshaping contemporary language practices. These systems, trained predominantly on corpora drawn from standardized or geopolitically dominant varieties, tend to normalize phonetic features that diverge from the reference norm, a phenomenon known as accent cleaning. This contribution examines this process through two questions: to what extent do automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems contribute to the reproduction of linguistic and social hierarchies, and what responsibility do researchers in the language sciences bear in relation to these biases? The central hypothesis is that these models privilege certain phonetic norms at the expense of diversity, producing forms of symbolic exclusion for speakers with marginalized accents. An exploratory comparative analysis examines three ASR systems (Google Speech-to-Text, OpenAI Whisper, and Amazon Transcribe) using a speech corpus from speakers of three contrasting varieties of French (standard French, Moroccan French, and sub-Saharan French). The anticipated results suggest significant asymmetries in word error rates (WER) and mechanisms of active normalization. The study aims to document these biases empirically and examine the researcher’s role from a digital ethics perspective.

abstractText: งานวิจัยนี้มุ่งศึกษาอิทธิพลของภาพลักษณ์ตราสินค้าโรงแรมสีเขียวและการรับรองสถานที่จัดงานสีเขียวที่มีต่อความตั้งใจเข้าร่วมอีเวนต์ในโรงแรมสีเขียว ผ่านการบูรณาการทฤษฎีการส่งสัญญาณ พร้อมทั้งตรวจสอบบทบาทของการรับรู้คุณค่าอีเวนต์สีเขียวในฐานะตัวแปรคั่นกลาง การศึกษาเชิงปริมาณนี้เก็บรวบรวมข้อมูลผ่านแบบสอบถามออนไลน์จากผู้ที่เคยเข้าร่วมงานอีเวนต์ในประเทศไทย จำนวน 332 คน และวิเคราะห์ข้อมูลด้วยแบบจำลองสมการโครงสร้างแบบ PLS-SEM ผลการวิจัยพบว่า การรับรองสถานที่จัดงานสีเขียว (สัญญาณเชิงรูปธรรม) ส่งผลต่อความตั้งใจเข้าร่วมอย่างมีนัยสำคัญ และมีอิทธิพลมากกว่าภาพลักษณ์ตราสินค้าโรงแรมสีเขียว (สัญญาณเชิงนามธรรม) ซึ่งชี้ให้เห็นว่าผู้บริโภคอาศัยหลักฐานที่ตรวจสอบได้ในการตัดสินใจ นอกจากนี้ ยังพบว่า การรับรู้คุณค่าอีเวนต์สีเขียว ซึ่งทำหน้าที่เป็นตัวแปรคั่นกลางบางส่วน กลับเป็นตัวแปรที่ส่งอิทธิพลต่อความตั้งใจเข้าร่วมสูงที่สุด งานวิจัยนี้จึงช่วยขยายขอบเขตความรู้ของทฤษฎีการส่งสัญญาณในบริบทพฤติกรรมด้านความยั่งยืน โดยชี้ให้เห็นว่าการแสดงหลักฐานที่น่าเชื่อถือขององค์กรอาจไม่เพียงพอ แต่ต้องสามารถสื่อสารคุณค่าที่จะช่วยยกระดับภาพลักษณ์ทางสังคมของผู้บริโภค จึงจะสามารถขับเคลื่อนการตัดสินใจได้อย่างยั่งยืน

title: СПЕЦИФІКА ОБРАЗУ ЧАРІВНИЦІ У РОМАНІ В. КЛИМЧУКА «РУТЕНІЯ. ПОВЕРНЕННЯ ВІДЬМИ»
abstractText: Образ відьми є одним із найцікавіших у світовій культурі. За спостереженням В. Кметь, «архетип відьми демонструє надзвичайну репрезентаційну активність як у фольклорному матеріалі, так і в текстах художньої літератури». Українська літературна традиція має багатий досвід осмислення цього образу – від рецепції демонологічних вірувань до складних художніх переосмислень. ХХІ століття принесло якісно нові інтерпретації, серед яких особливе місце посідає роман Віталія Климчука «Рутенія. Повернення відьми» — твір, що радикально переосмислює традиційний архетип відьми. В українській народній традиції відьма постає амбівалентною істотою, «що знається з нечистою силою, має магічні здібності та належить до категорії "непростих"». Етимологічно слово «відьма» пов'язане з коренем *vede — «знаю» та *vedati — «відати, знати», що підкреслює гносеологічну природу цього образу. В українській міфології існує багато варіантів жіночих демонологічних персонажів: відьма, гнилозубиця, віщунка, стрига, босорканя тощо.

INTERVENÇÕES FISIOTERAPÊUTICAS NA REABILITAÇÃO DE PACIENTES COM DOR PATELOFEMORAL
abstractText: Introdução: A dor patelofemoral é uma disfunção musculoesquelética multifatorial que pode causar dor, redução da força muscular e limitações funcionais. Objetivo: Analisar as evidências sobre as principais intervenções fisioterapêuticas utilizadas na reabilitação de pacientes com dor patelofemoral e seus efeitos sobre dor, força e função. Material e Métodos: Foi realizada revisão bibliográfica nas bases SciELO, LILACS, Periódicos CAPES e PubMed. Foram incluídos estudos publicados entre 2021 e 2026, em português, inglês ou espanhol, disponíveis gratuitamente em texto completo, realizados em seres humanos e relacionados às intervenções fisioterapêuticas na dor patelofemoral, priorizando ensaios clínicos randomizados. Resultados: Foram selecionados 10 estudos. Os resultados demonstraram redução da dor e melhora da função após intervenções. O fortalecimento muscular, de quadril e joelho, apresentou resultados positivos, assim como exercícios proprioceptivos, treinamento de equilíbrio e perturbação, exercícios para o pé, mobilidade do quadril e tornozelo e retreinamento da marcha. A estimulação elétrica e a bandagem patelar também apresentaram benefícios em desfechos. Discussão: Os achados indicam que o exercício terapêutico é fundamental na reabilitação, podendo ser associado a recursos complementares conforme os déficits apresentados. Intervenções direcionadas à força, estabilidade e controle neuromuscular favoreceram a redução da dor e a melhora funcional. A terapia manual apresentou benefícios, porém não demonstrou superioridade estatisticamente significativa quando associada aos exercícios. Conclusão: As intervenções fisioterapêuticas mostram resultados favoráveis na reabilitação da dor patelofemoral, especialmente na redução da dor e melhora da função e força.

title: IMPLEMENTASI KEBIJAKAN PERLINDUNGAN DAN PENGELOLAAN LINGKUNGAN HIDUP PERSPEKTIF SIYASAH TANFIDZIYYAH
abstractText: Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh permasalahan pengelolaan limbah air lindi di TPA Bakung, Kecamatan Teluk Betung Barat, Kota Bandar Lampung, yang masih menghadapi keterbatasan fasilitas pengolahan dan berpotensi menimbulkan dampak terhadap lingkungan masyarakat sekitar. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis implementasi Pasal 6 Ayat (3) Peraturan Daerah Kota Bandar Lampung Nomor 1 Tahun 2020 tentang Perlindungan dan Pengelolaan Lingkungan Hidup dalam pengendalian pencemaran limbah air lindi serta perspektif Siyasah Tanfidziyyah. Penelitian menggunakan metode field research dengan pendekatan kualitatif dan sifat deskriptif-analitis. Data diperoleh melalui wawancara, observasi, dan dokumentasi, kemudian dianalisis secara deskriptif-kualitatif dengan pendekatan deduktif. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa implementasi dilakukan melalui pemeliharaan fasilitas, pengujian kualitas air lindi, perbaikan IPAL, pembangunan saluran drainase, serta perubahan sistem open dumping menuju controlled landfill. Pelaksanaannya masih menghadapi keterbatasan fasilitas, belum tersedianya SOP khusus, kendala anggaran, serta keluhan masyarakat berupa bau dan kondisi air keruh ketika banjir. Dalam perspektif Siyasah Tanfidziyyah, pelaksanaan tersebut mencerminkan tanggung jawab pemerintah dalam menjalankan hukum dan mewujudkan kemaslahatan masyarakat. Kesimpulannya, implementasi telah berjalan, tetapi masih memerlukan penguatan fasilitas, pengawasan, dan prosedur pengendalian pencemaran. Dari Perspektif Siyasah Tanfidziyyah implementasi tersebut telah mencerminkan prinsip prinsip seperti Amanah, keadilan, kemaslahatan dan tanggung jawab.

title: Enhancing Naturalist Intelligence in Early Childhood Through Natural Materials
abstractText: Early childhood education is a crucial stage in preparing children to face further levels of schooling. One important aspect to be developed is naturalistic intelligence, which refers to the ability to recognize, differentiate, and appreciate the natural environment. This study aims to explore how teachers can enhance the naturalistic intelligence of children aged 5–6 years at Al Falah Islamic Kindergarten, Limbur Tembesi, Bathin VIII District, Sarolangun Regency through the use of natural materials. Employing a qualitative case study approach, data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation. The findings reveal that teachers play a central role in designing lesson plans semester programs, weekly lesson plans, and daily lesson plans that incorporate natural materials as learning media. Teachers also prepare items such as seeds, soil, stones, and vegetables, while instilling habits of caring for plants and maintaining cleanliness in the school environment. In conclusion, the structured and consistent use of natural materials fosters children’s naturalistic intelligence and nurtures environmental awareness from an early age.

title: GAMBARAN HISTOLOGI HEPAR TIKUS WISTAR (Rattus norvegicus) JANTAN SETELAH KONSUMSI IMBUHAN PAKAN MI SUBSTITUSI TEPUNG BIJI DURIAN (Durio zibethinus Murr.)
abstractText: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh imbuhan pakan mi substitusi tepung biji durian terhadap hepar tikus wistar (Rattus norvegicus) jantan. Penelitian ini menggunakan Rancangan Acak Lengkap (RAL), dengan 30 ekor tikus wistar yang dibagi dalam 5 kelompok perlakuan dan 6 kali ulangan. M0 (kontrol), M1 (perlakuan imbuhan pakan mi instan), M2 (perlakuan imbuhan pakan mi tepung terigu 100%), M3 (perlakuan imbuhan pakan mi substitusi tepung biji durian 25% dalam tepung terigu 75%), M4 (perlakuan imbuhan pakan mi substitusi tepung biji durian 50% dalam tepung terigu 50%). Perlakuan diberikan selama 1 bulan. Preparat hepar dibuat dengan metode parafin dan pewarnaan hematoksilin eosin. Data penelitian dianalisis menggunakan uji ANOVA pada taraf kepercayaan 95%. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan tidak ada perbedaan nyata (p>0,05) pada indeks hepatosomatik (IHS), tetapi berbeda nyata (p<0,05) pada jumlah konsumsi pakan, jumlah konsumsi air minum, diameter hepatosit, dan skor kerusakan hepatosit. Kesimpulan dari penelitian ini adalah imbuhan pakan mi substitusi tepung biji durian 25% dan 50% selama 30 hari tidak berpotensi menyebabkan perubahan pada struktur histologi hepar tikus wistar.

abstractText: У статті запропоновано концептуальний алгоритм підтримки прийняття рішень для управління ризиками воєнного часу в освітньому середовищі. Алгоритм поєднує отримання та перевірку повідомлень про небезпеку, класифікацію загроз, визначення обмежень щодо вибору допустимих безпечних дій і зворотний зв’язок. Для моделювання процесів управління ризиками в освітньому середовищі формалізовано показник якості інформації, сценарну оцінку ризику та критерій мінімізації втрат з урахуванням жорстких обмежень безпеки. Запропоновано показники оцінювання ефективності алгоритму для подальшої експериментальної перевірки. Розроблена модель має концептуальний характер і на цей час не реалізована програмно та не пройшла експериментальної валідації.

Translating Place Identity into Textile Motif Design
abstractText: Place identity is expressed through symbols, practices, and visual representations. Translating regional identity into textile motifs requires a systematic approach that connects local visual sources with meaningful design decisions. This study aims to identify Pangandaran's visual identity sources, translate them into textile motif compositions, and evaluate the resulting prototype. A practice-based design research approach was employed using a modified design thinking process incorporating a visual-semantic translation matrix. Five visual sources were identified and classified, with the Marlin Fish Monument serving as the primary motif, supported by coastal landscapes, fishing activities, marine biota, and vegetation. These sources were transformed through stylization, visual hierarchy, and repeat pattern development into three design alternatives. The selected coastal panorama composition was evaluated as a digital prototype by 17 respondents comprising textile industry experts, textile design academics, and potential users. Descriptive analysis revealed favourable perceptions of recognizability, visual distinctiveness, aesthetic quality, and textile applicability, with pooled mean scores ranging from 4.3 to 4.9. The findings provide preliminary evidence of perceived regional associations rather than independently verified recognition. This study contributes a traceable visual-semantic translation approach that connects regional identity sources with textile design decisions, offering a methodological reference for developing place-based textile products.

abstractText: การวิจัยครั้งนี้มีวัตถุประสงค์เพื่อ (1) วิเคราะห์การอ้างอิงในวิทยานิพนธ์และการค้นคว้าแบบอิสระ คณะเศรษฐศาสตร์ มหาวิทยาลัยเชียงใหม่ จำแนกตามประเภท ขอบเขตเนื้อหา ภาษา และอายุของทรัพยากรสารสนเทศที่นำไปอ้างอิง และ (2) ประเมินการใช้ทรัพยากรสารสนเทศของห้องสมุดคณะเศรษฐศาสตร์ มหาวิทยาลัยเชียงใหม่ จากการอ้างอิงในวิทยานิพนธ์และการค้นคว้าแบบอิสระ คณะเศรษฐศาสตร์ มหาวิทยาลัยเชียงใหม่ ประชากรที่ศึกษาคือวิทยานิพนธ์และการค้นคว้าแบบอิสระ ระดับบัณฑิตศึกษา คณะเศรษฐศาสตร์ ปีการศึกษา 2562-2566 จำนวน 249 ชื่อเรื่อง รวมรายการอ้างอิงทั้งสิ้น 10,363 รายการ เครื่องมือที่ใช้คือ แบบบันทึกข้อมูล วิเคราะห์ข้อมูลด้วยค่าความถี่และร้อยละ ผลการวิจัยพบว่า ทรัพยากรสารสนเทศประเภทวารสารได้รับการอ้างอิงมากที่สุด โดยส่วนใหญ่มีเนื้อหาด้านเศรษฐศาสตร์ ตีพิมพ์เป็นภาษาอังกฤษ และมีอายุทรัพยากรระหว่าง 0-5 ปี สำหรับผลการประเมินการใช้ทรัพยากรสารสนเทศพบว่า มีรายการอ้างอิงที่มีให้บริการในห้องสมุดคณะเศรษฐศาสตร์ และฐานข้อมูล EconLit™ with Full Text รวมจำนวน 3,580 รายการ คิดเป็นร้อยละ 34.55 ซึ่งอยู่ในระดับน้อย เมื่อจำแนกตามแหล่งให้บริการพบว่า เป็นทรัพยากรสารสนเทศที่มีให้บริการในห้องสมุดคณะเศรษฐศาสตร์ จำนวน 667 รายการ (ร้อยละ 6.44) โดยทรัพยากรสารสนเทศประเภทหนังสือได้รับอ้างอิงมากที่สุด จำนวน 510 รายการ (ร้อยละ 4.92) รองลงมาคือ วิทยานิพนธ์ จำนวน 150 รายการ (ร้อยละ 1.45) ในขณะที่เป็นทรัพยากรสารสนเทศที่มีให้บริการในฐานข้อมูล EconLit™ with Full Text จำนวน 2,981 รายการ (ร้อยละ 28.11) โดยประเภทวารสารได้รับอ้างอิงสูงสุด จำนวน 2,738 รายการ (ร้อยละ 26.42) รองลงมาคือ รายงานการวิจัย จำนวน 155 รายการ (ร้อยละ 1.50)

Dirty Ontology of Education
abstractText: Abstract Posthumanist, new materialist, and actor–network approaches increasingly draw attention to heterogeneous configurations of humans, technologies, infrastructures, and environments in which educational practices take place. At the same time, philosophical traditions of education insist that education cannot be reduced to relational complexity, since it requires normative distinctions that allow us to recognise education as education. These lines of thought are often treated as incompatible. This article argues that this tension points to a deeper feature of educational reality. I propose the concept of the dirty ontology of education to describe the condition in which pedagogical practices must reduce the complexity of the world to make education visible, while educational actions mobilise, stabilise, and transform relations that exceed these pedagogical reductions. Educational events are thus never pure: they become possible only through the ordering of heterogeneous relations, and this ordering can never be complete. Drawing on Mary Douglas’s analysis of dirt and Bruno Latour’s account of purification and hybridity, the paper shows how pedagogical strategies of ordering inevitably generate forms of excess that destabilise the boundaries through which education is defined. Rather than locating this “dirt” outside pedagogy, the article understands it as an internal feature of educational practice. Recognising the dirty ontology of education allows philosophy of education to move beyond the opposition between pedagogies of meaning and relational ontologies, and to develop a more adequate account of education as a practice that simultaneously orders and transforms the world.

title: HUBUNGAN MASA KERJA DAN TINGKAT PAPARAN RADIASI TERHADAP RISIKO GANGGUAN KESEHATAN PADA TENAGA KESEHATAN DI INSTALASI RADIOLOGI
abstractText: Sinar-X merupakan radiasi pengion yang dapat merusak sel hingga organ tubuh. Radiografer berisiko mengalami gangguan kesehatan karena sering berada di dekat sumber radiasi dalam waktu yang lama. Tujuan penelitian adalah untuk mengetahui hubungan masa kerja dan tingkat paparan radiasi sinar-X dengan risiko gangguan kesehatan pada tenaga kesehatan di instalasi radiologi. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kajian literatur atau literature review. Pencarian literatur dilakukan melalui Google Scholar dan Portal Garuda dengan kata kunci paparan radiasi sinar-X, masa kerja radiografer, tingkat dosis radiasi TLD, risiko gangguan kesehatan, dan instalasi radiologi. Didapatkan lima jurnal yang dianalisis dengan tabel ekstraksi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa dosis radiasi yang diterima pekerja masih jauh di bawah nilai batas dosis 20 mSv/tahun. Satu penelitian menemukan bahwa dosis radiasi dan beban kerja berhubungan dengan penurunan limfosit, sedangkan penelitian lainnya tidak menemukan hubungan bermakna dengan sel darah, fungsi hati, maupun fungsi ginjal. Masa kerja hanya berkaitan dengan jumlah eritrosit yang nilainya masih normal. Disimpulkan bahwa pada dosis rendah risiko gangguan kesehatan belum terbukti jelas, tetapi pengendalian waktu, jarak, perisai, penggunaan APD, dan pemeriksaan kesehatan berkala tetap diperlukan.

Knowledge producers or mere curators? A critical review of student learning and assignment dynamics in the era of artificial intelligence
abstractText: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into the university landscape offers unprecedented efficiency and speed, radically transforming how students access information and fulfill their academic responsibilities. However, this instantaneous convenience gives rise to a critical shift: do contemporary students remain autonomous knowledge producers, or have they been reduced to mere curators who synthesize and rearrange content from digital repositories? This paper critically examines the dynamics of student learning and assignment completion amidst the expanding AI ecosystem. Employing a reflective-critical approach, the article highlights the paradox of digital efficiency—which accelerates academic processes on one hand, yet risks diminishing critical depth, intellectual autonomy, and student creativity on the other. The analysis reveals that the relationship between students and AI is not merely instrumental; rather, it actively reshapes structural study habits, demanding a profound pedagogical redefinition to ensure that university institutions preserve the fundamental essence of knowledge creation.

EXAMINATION-RELATED STRESS, SLEEP DISTURBANCE, AND STUDENTS’ PERCEIVED TEST PERFORMANCE: A COMPARATIVE QUESTIONNAIRE STUDY AT GORI STATE UNIVERSITY AND EUROPEAN UNIVERSITY
abstractText: Background: Examination periods can coincide with psychological stress, sleep difficulties, and uncertainty about academic performance. Students may continue to feel tense while waiting for results or further assessment, particularly when they are unsure how well they answered the examination questions. Objective: To describe students’ reported stress and sleep difficulties before and after examinations at Gori State University and European University, and to explore themes appearing in anonymous open-ended questionnaire responses. Methods: The study is described as a comparative questionnaire study involving 50 students, with 25 participants from each university. Anonymous questionnaires were administered before and after an examination. The questionnaire asked about stress, sleep, feeling tired or sleepless, waiting for further assessment or results, and students’ perceptions of how they had answered the test. Results: The preliminary account supplied for this draft indicates that sleep difficulty associated with stress and concern while waiting for further assessment were recurring concerns in open-ended responses. The initial estimate was approximately 5% of students reporting satisfaction with their answers. With 50 participants, the closest possible whole-person counts are 2 students (4%) or 3 students (6%); the original questionnaires must be checked to establish which count is correct. No further frequency estimates or statistical tests are reported because participant-level data were not provided for analysis. Conclusion: Anonymous pre- and post-examination questionnaires may help educators identify students’ concerns about sleep, stress, and uncertainty. Findings should be interpreted as preliminary until response counts, scoring procedures, ethics information, and the exact number of students reporting satisfaction are verified.

abstractText: อุตสาหกรรมการท่องเที่ยวเผชิญความท้าทายเชิงซ้อนจากความผันผวนของอุปสงค์ แรงกดดันต่อสิ่งแวดล้อม และความเหลื่อมล้ำเชิงพื้นที่ ทำให้องค์กรเพื่อสังคม (Social Enterprises: SEs) จำเป็นต้องพัฒนานวัตกรรมเพื่อเชื่อมพันธกิจทางสังคมเข้ากับความสามารถในการแข่งขันและการยืนระยะในตลาด อย่างไรก็ตามองค์ความรู้ที่มีอยู่ยังมักอธิบายนวัตกรรม ระบบนิเวศสนับสนุน และปัจจัยเกื้อหนุนแบบในภาพที่แยกส่วน จนขาดกรอบเชิงระบบที่ชี้กลไกการยกระดับจากต้นแบบสู่การขยายผลในบริบทการท่องเที่ยว โดยบทความวิชาการนี้มีวัตถุประสงค์เพื่อ (1) เพื่อวิเคราะห์กรอบคิดพื้นฐานและความท้าทายขององค์กรเพื่อสังคม (2) เพื่อศึกษารูปแบบและขอบเขตของการประยุกต์ใช้นวัตกรรม และ (3) เพื่อระบุและประเมินองค์ประกอบสำคัญของระบบนิเวศที่เอื้อต่อนวัตกรรม โดยใช้ระเบียบวิธีทบทวนวรรณกรรมเชิงสังเคราะห์จากบทความวิชาการ และเอกสารเชิงนโยบายที่เกี่ยวข้อง ผลการสังเคราะห์ชี้ว่า นวัตกรรมขององค์กรเพื่อสังคมการท่องเที่ยว ทำหน้าที่เป็นกลไกเชื่อมพันธกิจทางสังคมกับตรรกะตลาดอย่างเป็นรูปธรรม ผ่านการออกแบบประสบการณ์ที่ยกระดับชุมชนเป็นผู้ร่วมสร้างและผู้ประกอบการ พร้อมทั้งต้องอาศัยระบบสนับสนุนเชิงสถาบัน เช่น กรอบกฎหมาย มาตรการจูงใจ แพลตฟอร์มบ่มเพาะ และเครื่องมือวัดผลกระทบ เป็นต้น เพื่อย่นระยะจากการทดลองสู่การใช้งานจริงและการขยายผล บทความจึงเสนอกรอบมุมมองเชิงระบบที่บูรณาการนวัตกรรม ระบบนิเวศ และปัจจัยเกื้อหนุน เพื่อระบุจุดคานงัดเชิงนโยบายและการจัดการที่ช่วยให้องค์กรเพื่อสังคมการท่องเที่ยวไทย ขับเคลื่อนจากการเติบโตเชิงปริมาณไปสู่การเติบโตเชิงคุณค่าได้อย่างยั่งยืน

title: Ferroelectric Nanotubes: From Fabrication to Property Control
abstractText: Ferroelectric materials have a wide range of applications owing to their anisotropic physical properties, such as a high dielectric constant, pyroelectricity, and piezoelectricity. The high piezoelectric coefficient of Pb(Zr,Ti)O3 (PZT) (d33 = 200‒600 pC/N) makes it one of the most widely used ferroelectric materials. Ferroelectric nanostructures are considered highly promising for applications, such as actuators, transducers, and energy harvesters. We report the template-directed growth of PZT nanotubes by combining a sol-gel process with spin coating. Field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FESEM) images show that the PZT nanotubes are well packed inside the pores of a porous alumina membrane (PAM). A well-saturated hysteresis loop is observed in these ferroelectric PZT nanotubes, confirming their ferroelectric switching behavior. The piezoresponse of the nanotubes is quantitatively evaluated, and free-standing nanotubes are found to exhibit a higher response than nanotubes clamped by the PAM. These results suggest that lateral clamping can reduce the piezoresponse. These PZT nanotube arrays may offer a route toward artificial skin, touchpads, bio-imaging, and nanogenerators.

title: SENESCÊNCIA DE FIBROBLASTOS E REMODELAMENTO DA MATRIZ EXTRACELULAR NA CICATRIZAÇÃO CUTÂNEA: POTENCIAL DE BIOMARCADORES MOLECULARES NA IDENTIFICAÇÃO PRECOCE DE FERIDAS COM RISCO DE CRONIFICAÇÃO
abstractText: A cicatrização cutânea depende de interações temporais entre fibroblastos, células imunes, microcirculação e matriz extracelular. A senescência celular transitória pode favorecer a reparação; sua persistência, em contrapartida, tem sido associada à inflamação prolongada, à desorganização proteolítica e à perda de capacidade regenerativa. Este artigo analisa criticamente o papel da senescência de fibroblastos no remodelamento matricial e investiga o potencial de biomarcadores moleculares para reconhecer, precocemente, feridas com risco de não cicatrização. Foi desenvolvida revisão sistematizada qualitativa com síntese narrativa, baseada em literatura científica identificável, sem dados clínicos originais nem estimativas de desempenho diagnóstico próprias. São discutidos p16, p21, atividade de beta-galactosidase associada à senescência, mediadores do fenótipo secretor associado à senescência, metaloproteinases e seus inibidores, mediadores inflamatórios e marcadores de estresse oxidativo. Evidências experimentais sustentam a dualidade funcional da senescência, enquanto revisões clínicas sobre fluido de feridas apontam interesse especial nas metaloproteinases, sobretudo MMP-9, mas registram heterogeneidade metodológica e ausência de limiares prognósticos universalmente validados. Conclui-se que painéis multiparamétricos integrados à avaliação clínica podem ser promissores, desde que validados prospectivamente por tipo de ferida, temporalidade, acurácia e utilidade decisória.

Adaptasi Aktivitas Buku Teks menjadi Permainan Kelompok dalam Pembelajaran Bahasa Inggris di MAN Kota Palangka Raya
abstractText: Kegiatan Pengabdian kepada Masyarakat (PkM) dalam program MBKM Asistensi Mengajar di MAN Kota Palangka Raya dilaksanakan sebagai alternatif pengembangan aktivitas pembelajaran Bahasa Inggris melalui adaptasi latihan buku teks menjadi permainan kelompok. Kegiatan ini bertujuan mendeskripsikan proses adaptasi Whilst-listening Activity 3 dan Post-listening Activity 5 pada Unit 1 Be Good on Social Media dalam buku Pathway to English for SMA/MA Grade XI. Metode yang digunakan adalah pendampingan pembelajaran berbasis permainan dengan melibatkan 73 peserta didik kelas XI-B dan XI-C selama 135 menit. Aktivitas menyimak diadaptasi melalui kartu pernyataan dan pertukaran informasi, sedangkan aktivitas pascamenyimak dikembangkan melalui pencarian kartu, klasifikasi komentar Friendly dan Rude, pencocokan komentar dengan kalimat koreksi, serta praktik ungkapan yang lebih santun. Hasil kegiatan berupa rancangan permainan kelompok dan media pembelajaran yang mengintegrasikan keterampilan menyimak, pemahaman kosakata, kolaborasi, dan kesantunan berbahasa dalam komunikasi digital. Keunggulan kegiatan terletak pada prosedur terstruktur dan penggunaan media konkret untuk mendukung penyelesaian tugas bersama. Namun, dampaknya terhadap hasil belajar dan sikap peserta didik belum dapat dipastikan karena tidak tersedia data evaluasi formal. Kegiatan ini dapat menjadi alternatif adaptasi latihan buku teks dengan pengembangan evaluasi yang lebih sistematis pada pelaksanaan selanjutnya.

abstractText: У статті запропоновано концептуальну рамку створення інклюзивних навчальних матеріалів для підготовки соціальних працівників. Розмежовано три виміри інклюзивності: педагогічний (UDL 3.0), технічний (WCAG 2.1 і 2.2) та професійно-етичний (правозахисний, критичний і партисипативний підходи), і показано, що відповідність одному з них не гарантує відповідності іншим. Запропоновано п'ять принципів синтезу, правила узгодження конфліктів між вимірами та аналітичну матрицю, які проілюстровано умовним прикладом. abstractText: การวิจัยครั้งนี้มีวัตถุประสงค์ 1) เพื่อศึกษาการรับรู้ความเท่าเทียมของความหลากหลายทางเพศ ในการทำงาน 2) เพื่อศึกษาการรับรู้ความสำเร็จในการทำงานของพนักงานที่มีความหลากหลายทางเพศในองค์กร 3) เพื่อศึกษาอิทธิพลของปัจจัยในการรับรู้ความเท่าเทียมของพนักงานที่มีความหลากหลายทางเพศในการทำงาน ที่มีต่อการรับรู้ความสำเร็จในการทำงานของพนักงาน การวิจัยเป็นเชิงปริมาณ กลุ่มตัวอย่าง คือ พนักงานตรวจรับลงทะเบียน ท่าอากาศยานสุวรรณภูมิ จำนวนทั้งสิ้น 416 ราย เครื่องมือที่ใช้ในการเก็บข้อมูล คือ แบบสอบถาม และได้รับกลับทั้งหมด สถิติที่ใช้ ได้แก่ จำนวนร้อยละ ค่าเฉลี่ย ส่วนเบี่ยงเบนมาตรฐาน และการวิเคราะห์การถดถอยพหุคูณ ผลการศึกษาพบว่า การรับรู้ความเท่าเทียมของความหลากหลายทางเพศในการทำงานโดยรวมอยู่ในระดับมากที่สุด เมื่อพิจารณารายด้าน อันดับแรก ได้แก่ ด้านการยอมรับทางสังคมในพนักงานที่มีความหลากหลายทางเพศ รองลงมา ได้แก่ ด้านการให้ความเสมอภาคทางสังคมกับพนักงานที่มีความหลากหลายทางเพศ ตามลำดับ ผลการศึกษาปัจจัยการรับรู้ความสำเร็จในการทำงาน ในภาพรวมอยู่ในระดับมากที่สุดเช่นเดียวกัน ผลการศึกษาการถดถอยพหุคูณ พบว่า การรับความเท่าเทียมของพนักงานที่มีความหลากหลายทางเพศ ในการทำงาน ส่งผลต่อการรับรู้ความสำเร็จของการทำงานของพนักงาน อย่างมีนัยสำคัญทางสถิติที่ระดับ 0.01 โดยสามารถร่วมกันทำนายได้ร้อยละ 49 ทั้งนี้ตัวแปรที่มีผลต่อการรับรู้ความสำเร็จในการทำงานมากที่สุดคือ ความพึงพอใจในการร่วมงานกับพนักงานที่มีความหลากหลายทางเพศ (β = .51) รองลงมาได้แก่ การให้ความเสมอภาคทางสังคมกับพนักงานที่มีความหลากหลายทางเพศ (β = .31) ผลการวิจัยนี้สามารถใช้เป็นแนวทางในการกำหนดนโยบาย เพื่อส่งเสริมด้านการคุ้มครองทางเพศ โดยเฉพาะการคุ้มครองสิทธิ เสรีภาพด้านแรงงาน และองค์กรสามารถนำผลการศึกษาไปกำหนดกรอบนโยบายด้านความเท่าเทียม ในการเสริมสร้างขวัญกำลังใจ และประสิทธิภาพในการปฏิบัติงานของพนักงานบริการด้านการบิน นอกจากนี้ยังเป็นประโยชน์สำหรับนักวิจัย อาจารย์ นักศึกษา รวมถึงประชาชนทั่วไป เพื่อใช้เป็นแนวทางในการศึกษาวิจัย โดยนำข้อมูลสำคัญที่ได้จากการวิจัย ไปใช้ประกอบการศึกษา รวมถึงนำไปต่อยอดให้เกิดองค์ความรู้ใหม่ และบูรณาการทางด้านการศึกษาต่อไป

Thermal buffering by termite mounds maintains safety margins while worker traits track climate
abstractText: Abstract Understanding how environmental conditions influence organismal performance requires linking physiological limits with the microclimates actually experienced by individuals. In mound-building termites, nest architecture can modify thermal exposure, yet its consequences for physiological and functional variation remain poorly understood. We combined experimental measurements of critical thermal maximum (CT max ), field measurements of mound microclimate, mechanistic estimates of operative body temperature, and analyses of morphological, enzymatic, and gut bacterial traits to examine responses of Cornitermes cumulans across a climatic gradient. At the Campinas site, mound interiors showed markedly lower thermal variation than ambient conditions, while modelled operative temperatures indicated positive thermal safety margins across the broader climatic gradient. Nevertheless, CT max remained associated with regional climate, increasing with annual precipitation and decreasing with mean diurnal temperature range. Worker morphology also varied strongly with climatic conditions, while β-glucanase activity and gut bacterial richness were associated with different climatic drivers. Future projections indicated substantial reductions in thermal safety margins under SSP2–4.5 and SSP5–8.5 scenarios, with greater losses at lower latitudes and progressively smaller reductions toward higher latitudes. These findings suggest that mound-mediated buffering reduces direct exposure to thermal extremes without eliminating climatic effects on physiological and functional traits. Architectural niche construction may therefore generate a Bogert-like effect in which thermal buffering maintains current safety margins but does not fully protect colonies from future warming, particularly at lower latitudes.

Synthesis and characterization of new thiadiazole ligand and its Co(II), Ni(II), and Cu(II) complexes: Cyclic voltammetry (CV) and preliminary in vitro evaluation of the free ligand
abstractText: The thiadiazole-based ligand (L1) and its Co(II), Ni(II), and Cu(II) complexes were synthesized and characterized using physicochemical methods, as well as supported by various spectroscopic techniques. FT-IR and UV–Visible spectroscopy, along with molar conductivity studies, supported the intended mode of coordination of ligands with metal ions and authenticated the proposed geometry of the complexes. Cyclic voltammetry studies were carried out to get an insight into the redox properties of the synthesized complexes. The redox couples were assigned, and reversibility of the reaction was assessed by calculating various electrochemical parameters like the ratio of anodic- to cathodic peak current (Ipa/Ipc) and peak potential difference (ΔEp). Results showed that the metal complexes displayed encouraging redox features, which are indicative of metal influence on the ligand electron attributes. Preliminary in vitro cytotoxicity screening of the free ligand L1 was performed against HBL-100 human breast epithelial cells and the MCF-7 breast cancer cells. Compound L1 did not reach 50% inhibition at the tested concentrations (15, 30, and 45 µg/mL); therefore, the IC₅₀ value was not determined under the experimental conditions.

title: PRE-EXAMINATION STRESS AMONG UNIVERSITY STUDENTS: ACADEMIC ASPIRATIONS, PASSING-GRADE CONCERNS, AND A COMPARATIVE STUDY AT GORI STATE UNIVERSITY AND EUROPEAN UNIVERSITY
abstractText: Background: Examinations can trigger stress related to performance expectations, uncertainty, and the consequences of receiving a particular grade. Stress may be especially salient for students seeking the highest grade and for students who need a minimum passing grade to complete a course. Objective: To outline a comparative investigation of pre-examination stress among students at Gori State University and European University, with particular attention to students aiming for an A (91–100 points) and students for whom an E-range result (51–60 points) may be sufficient to complete the subject. Methods: The proposed cross-sectional study includes 50 students, 25 from each university. A brief questionnaire should record perceived stress before the examination, grade-related expectations, perceived consequences of the result, and basic demographic/academic variables. Results: The numerical example in this draft is illustrative only and does not represent verified participant data. It demonstrates a reporting structure in which stress scores are compared by university and by grade-related concern. Conclusion: Grade-related expectations and fear of failing may represent different pathways to examination stress. Actual conclusions require analysis of the completed dataset.

title: Design and Fabrication of Betel Nut Dryer Using Mesh System
abstractText: The drying of betel nut is an essential post-harvesting process that directly influences its quality, shelf life, and market value. Traditional sun-drying methods are highly time- consuming, weather-dependent, and prone to contamination, while conventional solid-tray dryers restrict airflow and cause non-uniform drying. This project focuses on the design and fabrication of an improved betel nut dryer by replacing the existing tray system with a mesh- based drying arrangement to enhance airflow penetration and drying efficiency. The dryer consists of a mild steel frame, a thermally insulated chamber, stainless-steel mesh trays, fin- type electric heating coils, and an AC blower to facilitate forced convection. The mesh tray design allows hot air to pass uniformly from both top and bottom surfaces, significantly reducing drying time and improving consistency. A temperature control system ensures safe and optimized operation within the required drying range. Experimental observations confirm that the mesh system provides better moisture removal, reduced energy consumption, and improved product quality compared to traditional tray dryers. Betel nut, commonly known as areca nut, is an important commercial crop cultivated in several tropical regions, particularly in India. It is widely used for chewing and in various traditional and commercial products. After harvesting, betel nuts contain a significant amount of moisture, which must be reduced to improve their storage life, maintain quality, and prevent the growth of mould and other microorganisms. Therefore, proper drying is an essential step in betel nut processing.Traditionally, betel nuts are dried by spreading them under direct sunlight. Although this method is economical, it has several disadvantages, including dependence on weather conditions, longer drying time, uneven moisture removal, contamination by dust and insects, and the requirement for a large drying area. These limitations highlight the need for an improved and efficient drying system.

abstractText: Permasalahan sampah merupakan salah satu tantangan yang di hadapi masyarakat dalam menjaga kebersihan dan kenyamanan lingkungan. Ketersediaan sarana penampungan sampah menjadi salah satu faktor yang dapat mendukung kebiasaan masyarakat dalam membuang sampah pada tempatnya. Kegiatan ini bertujuan untuk memanfaatkan drum sebagai sarana pengelolaan sampah sekaligus mendukung peningkatan kebersihan lingkungan di Desa Wajogu, Kecamatan Lakudo, Kabupaten Buton Tengah. Metode pelaksanaan kegiatan meliputi observasi kondisi lingkungan, identifikasi kebutuhan masyarakat, koordinasi dengan pemerintah desa dan masyarakat, persiapan bahan, pembuatan serta penataan drum, penempatan sarana di lingkungan setiap dusun, dan evaluasi pemanfaatannya. Hasil kegiatan menunjukkan bahwa pemanfaatan drum dapat menjadi alternatif sarana penampungan sampah yang sederhana, mudah ditempatkan, dan dapat disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan lingkungan desa. Penempatan sarana pada beberapa dusun diharapkan dapat memudahkan masyarakat dalam membuang sampah serta mengurangi sampah yang berserakan di lingkungan.

title: Hydrophobic modification regulates the water microenvironment at the interface of Cu-based materials to promote E-CO 2 RR
abstractText: Electrocatalytic CO2 reduction (E-CO2RR) powered by renewable energy is vital for carbon cycling and carbon neutrality. Cu-based catalysts uniquely produce multi-carbon (C2+) products, yet the interfacial water microenvironment and reaction kinetics remain poorly understood. This work fabricates hydrophobic HY-Cu2O (100) catalysts by self-assembling octadecanethiol on cubic (100)-faced Cu2O nanoparticles to tune interfacial water. Integrated characterizations, electrochemistry, and in situ Attenuated Total Reflection Surface-Enhanced Infrared Absorption Spectroscopy (ATR-SEIRAS) reveal how hydrophobicity regulates E-CO2RR performance. Hydrophilic/hydrophobic contact-angle measurements reveal that the surface wetting angle changes from 46.1° (hydrophilic) to 133.5° (hydrophobic). X-ray diffraction (XRD) confirms that the crystal structure remains unchanged. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) results demonstrate that the Cu-S coordination environment of the material is modified. Further inference suggests that the formation of Cu-S bonds verifies the successful functional grafting of octadecyl chains onto the Cu2O (100) surface, which alters the surface hydrophilicity/hydrophobicity without inducing any variation in the crystal structure. In 1 M KOH flow cells, HY-Cu2O delivers 45.2% Faradaic efficiency for ethylene at -250 mA∙cm-2 and suppresses parasitic Hydrogen Evolution Reaction (HER), far exceeding bare Cu2O. In situ spectra and theory verify that hydrophobic interfaces accumulate K+-bound free water, disrupt interfacial hydrogen bonds, accelerate *CO protonation, and boost C-C coupling for C2+ intermediates. Higher surface CO coverage further kinetically favors C2+ formation. This work establishes an effective hydrophobic modification approach, clarifies the central role of interfacial water in ethylene selectivity, and offers guidance for the design of advanced CO2RR catalysts.

title: Effects of Carboxymethyl Cellulose and Glycerol on the Physical Properties of Soy Protein -Based Bioplastics
abstractText: Biodegradable plastic is a food packaging that is widely developed today because of its properties that can be degraded by soil biota. In this study, biodegradable plastics based on soy protein obtained from solid waste of the tofu industry were developed. This study was conducted to see the effect of variations of Carboxymethyl Cellulose (CMC) and Glycerol on the physical characteristics of plastic materials made from soy protein. CMC with concentrations of 1, 1.5, and 2 % (w/w) and glycerol 0, 30, 50, 70% were mixed with soy protein with a concentration of 10% and formed a film by the casting method. The results showed that the addition of CMC and glycerol had an effect on the moisture content and solubility of the resulting plastic. Based on all the physical characteristics tested (moisture content, solubility, thickness, heat resistance and biodegradability tests), the best treatment was obtained at the treatment of CMC concentration of 1.5% and glycerol 30%.

title: Opinion Mining for Product Reviews Using Artificial Intelligence
abstractText: The rapid growth of e-commerce platforms has resulted in a large volume of customer-generated product reviews. These reviews contain valuable information about customer opinions, satisfaction levels, product quality, and specific product features. However, manually analysing a large number of reviews is time-consuming and difficult. Opinion mining, also known as sentiment analysis, uses Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing techniques to automatically identify and classify opinions expressed in textual reviews. This paper presents a conceptual AI-based framework for analysing product reviews and identifying their sentiment polarity as positive, negative, or neutral. The proposed approach combines contextual language representation using Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) with aspect-based sentiment analysis inspired by Aspect-specific Graph Convolutional Networks (ASGCN). The system performs review preprocessing, contextual feature extraction, aspect identification, sentiment classification, and generation of an overall opinion summary. The reviewed literature also includes hybrid BERT-CNN architectures, user/context-aware graph modelling, and multimodal learning approaches, which provide additional directions for improving opinion analysis. The proposed framework aims to provide more detailed and meaningful information than simple positive or negative classification by identifying the product aspects responsible for customer opinions. Such a system can assist customers in decision-making and help businesses understand product strengths, weaknesses, and areas requiring improvement

title: Acute medicine at the hospital front door: A Singapore health system priority
abstractText: Hospital crowding in Singapore is often experienced at the emergency department front door, but for many older and medically complex adults, it may signal vulnerabilities across the early acute care pathway. Delayed senior decision-making, fragmented handover between emergency and inpatient teams, limited alternatives to admission, and weak transitions back to community care create risks to safety, patient experience, and bed capacity. Acute medicine offers a practical way to redesign this interval by concentrating diagnostic breadth, senior review, rapid diagnostics, multidisciplinary assessment, and disposition planning during the first 48–72 hours of undifferentiated acute medical illness. This commentary argues that the policy value of acute medicine in Singapore lies not in replicating a UK specialty model but in defining how its core functions can complement existing medical and emergency care pathways. It examines progress in Singapore, distinguishes acute medicine from adjacent models of care, and identifies the workforce, governance, and measurement requirements for further development.

abstractText: У статті досліджено особливості цифровізації освітнього простору та її вплив на процес викладання сучасної української мови. Розглянуто можливості використання цифрових платформ, інформаційно-комунікаційних технологій, мультимедійних ресурсів і засобів штучного інтелекту в освітньому процесі. Проаналізовано їхній потенціал для підвищення ефективності навчання, удосконалення методів викладання, розвитку комунікативної компетентності здобувачів освіти та формування навичок критичного мислення і самостійної навчальної діяльності. Визначено переваги застосування інтерактивних інструментів навчання, електронних освітніх ресурсів і технологій штучного інтелекту під час вивчення сучасної української мови. Окреслено основні виклики, пов’язані з цифровою трансформацією освітнього середовища, зокрема питання цифрової грамотності, адаптації педагогічних практик та забезпечення якості освітнього процесу. Обґрунтовано перспективи подальшого розвитку цифрової мовної освіти в умовах сучасних суспільних і технологічних змін.
