abstractText: Merchandising business accounting is often considered one of the most confusing topics for high school students. In a single chapter, students encounter purchases, returns, discounts, freight, inventory, and cost of goods sold, often before they fully understand service business accounting. This community service program aimed to help eleventh-grade students at SMA Kristen Yusuf understand how a merchandising business records its transactions, from buying goods to calculating gross profit. The program was held on-site and combined a short lecture, a case study of a fictional shop called "Toko Abadi Sejahtera", small-group exercises guided by university students, and an open discussion. The study measured students' understanding with a pre-test and post-test and observed their participation throughout the session. The average post-test score was higher than the pre-test score, with the clearest improvement in calculating cost of goods sold and gross profit. Students found the material easier to follow when transactions were presented as the story of a running shop rather than as a list of accounts. The distinction between periodic and perpetual inventory systems, however, remained the most challenging part. These results suggest that short, practice-based training built around everyday business examples can support classroom accounting lessons, and that follow-up sessions should give more time to perpetual inventory recording.

title: DEPOIS DA PROVA TRADICIONAL: AVALIAÇÃO AUTÊNTICA, AUTORIA DISCENTE E INTEGRIDADE ACADÊMICA NA ERA DA INTELIGÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL GENERATIVA
abstractText: A expansão da inteligência artificial generativa tornou insuficiente a suposição de que o produto escrito, isoladamente, demonstra o domínio individual de conhecimentos e habilidades. Este artigo discute como redesenhar a avaliação educacional para preservar aprendizagem, autoria discente e integridade acadêmica em contextos nos quais sistemas generativos podem participar da pesquisa, redação e revisão de trabalhos. Adota-se revisão sistematizada qualitativa com síntese narrativa de publicações acadêmicas e orientações institucionais, sem coleta primária de dados ou pretensão de metanálise. O estudo relaciona avaliação autêntica, validade das inferências avaliativas, regulação pedagógica, competências em inteligência artificial e justiça educacional. Argumenta-se que a resposta à geração automática de textos não se limita à fiscalização de plágio nem à eliminação de provas: depende de tarefas contextualizadas, registros de percurso, defesas dialogadas, rubricas transparentes, declaração proporcional de ferramentas utilizadas e oportunidades equitativas de aprendizagem. A análise identifica tensões entre autenticidade e padronização, transparência e privacidade, autonomia e dependência tecnológica, além de discutir riscos de falsos positivos em procedimentos de detecção. Propõe-se uma matriz conceitual de redesenho avaliativo baseada em objetivos de aprendizagem, evidências múltiplas, mediação docente, autoria responsável e revisão institucional de políticas. Conclui-se que a integridade acadêmica deve ser concebida como prática formativa, sustentada por critérios explícitos e condições justas de participação, e não somente como controle repressivo da produção textual.

title: Lived Experiences of Caregivers of Children With Neurodevelopmental Conditions in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia: A Phenomenological Study
abstractText: Caregivers of children with neurodevelopmental disorders experience significant multifaceted burdens. However, little qualitative research has been done to explore caregivers’ lived experiences in relation to the effect of burden and coping strategies in the study area. The study sought to investigate caregivers’ awareness problems, coping mechanisms, and support systems in caring for children with neurodevelopmental disorders in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The study was conducted in three public, non-teaching hospitals in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Using a descriptive phenomenological technique. In-depth interviews were conducted with 15 purposively selected caregivers. The data was analyzed using Braun and Clarke’s six-phase framework technique. The analysis found six interrelated themes: Awareness and Perception of Neurodevelopmental Disorders (NDDs), Emotional Responses to Diagnosis and Adaptation, Caregiving Roles and Responsibilities, Multidimensional Burden and Challenges, Coping Strategies and Adaptation Mechanisms, and Support Systems and Structural Barriers. Bronfenbrenner’s ecological systems theory was used to explain how personal, institutional, and systemic factors explain participants’ experiences and interpret caregiving realities. These findings underscore the call for integrated and collaborative efforts to address individual and system-level challenges among caregivers. Enhancing support systems, mitigating stigma, and correcting systemic inadequacies can improve caregiver well-being and optimize care for children with NDDs.

title: CARACTERÍSTICAS ASSOCIADAS À AMPUTAÇÃO OU DESARTICULAÇÃO EM HOSPITALIZAÇÕES POR OSTEOMIELITE CRÔNICA NO AMAZONAS, 2010–2025
abstractText: Este estudo analisou as características associadas à realização de amputação ou desarticulação entre hospitalizações por osteomielite crônica submetidas a tratamento cirúrgico osteomuscular no Amazonas, entre 2010 e 2025. A análise retrospectiva utilizou dados do Sistema de Informações Hospitalares do Sistema Único de Saúde e incluiu hospitalizações por osteomielite crônica, definida pelos códigos M86.3–M86.6 da CID-10, submetidas a cirurgia do sistema osteomuscular. O desfecho correspondeu à amputação ou desarticulação registrada como procedimento principal. As associações foram estimadas por Equações de Estimação Generalizadas, considerando o agrupamento por estabelecimento hospitalar. Foram analisadas 250 hospitalizações, das quais 138 (55,2%) apresentaram o desfecho. No modelo ajustado, a internação em caráter de urgência apresentou maior chance de amputação/desarticulação (OR=4,52; IC95% 1,56–13,09; p=0,005), assim como cada incremento de 10 anos de idade (OR=1,73; IC95% 1,51–1,99; p<0,001). Sexo e fluxo assistencial não apresentaram associação independente. Maior idade e internação de urgência estiveram associadas ao desfecho, contribuindo para caracterizar uma população cirúrgica de elevada complexidade e para o planejamento da assistência especializada.

Antibiotic Prescribing for Outpatient Dental Infections Across a Michigan Health System
abstractText: Abstract Background Penicillins are recommended first-line for the treatment of dental infections; however, alternatives are often prescribed which may increase risk of treatment failure. This study aimed to describe prescribing patterns for outpatient dental infections across a Michigan healthcare system and to compare patient outcomes associated with different antibiotics. Methods This was a multicenter, retrospective cohort study evaluating adult patients treated for a dental infection from an outpatient site between January 1, 2020 – August 1, 2025. Patients were compared via four groups: amoxicillin/clavulanate, cephalosporins, clindamycin, and other. The primary objective was to compare treatment failure between groups, which was defined as need for new or extension of current antimicrobial therapy within 30 days of presentation. Results 12,365 patients were treated for dental infection. Penicillins were most often prescribed (75.6%) followed by clindamycin (19.1%). 594 patients were evaluated for treatment failure which occurred most frequently in patients receiving clindamycin (11.3%), followed by cephalosporins (4.8%), amoxicillin/clavulanate (2%), and other agents (0.7%) (p<0.001). Of the patients receiving penicillin alternatives, 21.4% had no documented allergy or intolerance while 26.8% had only a mild allergy or intolerance. Clindamycin (OR 6.2 [95% CI 2.5-15.81]) and cefdinir (OR 9.9 [95% CI 2.67-36.97]) were independently associated with treatment failure. Conclusions Outpatient prescribing for dental infections across a health system revealed a preference for first-line penicillins and an opportunity to improve penicillin use in patients with and without beta-lactam allergy. Clindamycin and cefdinir were independently associated with treatment failure; alternative agents should be prioritized in patients unable to receive penicillins.

title: Organizational and User Perception Factors Influencing Accounting Information System Effectiveness in Small and Medium Enterprises: A Case Study of Registered Legal Entities in the Songkhla Special Economic Zone
abstractText: This study aims to investigate (1) the level of challenges in the use of Accounting Information Systems (AIS) among small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), (2) organizational and user perception factors influencing AIS performance, and (3) the differences in AIS challenges and performance classified by firm characteristics, including business type, number of employees, annual revenue, and duration of AIS implementation. The study is grounded in the Technology–Organization–Environment (TOE) framework and the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM). The sample consisted of 137 SMEs registered as juristic persons in the Songkhla Special Economic Zone. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire and analyzed through descriptive statistics, independent samples t-test, one-way ANOVA, and multiple regression analysis. The findings reveal that SMEs experience AIS usage challenges at a moderate level (x̄ = 2.99), particularly in terms of organizational readiness and support. Meanwhile, the overall AIS performance is rated at a high level ( x̄ = 4.02). The comparative analysis indicated significant differences in AIS challenges and effectiveness among firms with different business types, numbers of employees, annual revenues, and durations of AIS usage. The results of the multiple regression analysis showed that organizational readiness and support, as well as perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use, had significant positive effects on AIS effectiveness (p < 0.05). Perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use exerted the strongest influence (B = 0.521), followed by organizational readiness and support (B = 0.109). Together, these factors explained 54.8% of the variance in AIS effectiveness (R² = 0.548). The findings suggest that enhancing organizational readiness and promoting users’ perceptions of the usefulness of AIS should be supported by both government agencies and business operators. Such efforts would contribute to improving AIS effectiveness and strengthening the long-term competitiveness and sustainability of SMEs.

title: Life cycle assessments of vehicle components: an overview
abstractText: Abstract The development and manufacturing of automotive components with reduced environmental impacts is needed to decrease the overall ecological burden of vehicles. Although individual vehicle components have been scientifically evaluated and the findings published for decades, there is still a lack of a summarized listing of these case studies. This study presents a systematic literature review (SLR) of life cycle assessments (LCAs) on vehicle components, excluding batteries and tires. After exclusion of unrelated publications, 129 results were used for further analysis. This sample contains 160 LCA studies conducted since 1995. The analysis identified recurring themes and key trends in impact categories, methodologies, and software tools. Structural and powertrain components appeared to be the most frequently assessed. While lightweight and material selection emerged as the most prominent and still trending aspects, climate change and energy demand turned out as to be dominant indicators. Besides insights into the current state of LCA implementation within the automotive (supply) industry, this research also reveals a few gaps.

BIOESTIMULAÇÃO DE COLÁGENO E REGENERAÇÃO DA MATRIZ DÉRMICA: INFLUÊNCIA DA ATIVIDADE FIBROBLÁSTICA, DOS MEDIADORES INFLAMATÓRIOS E DA QUALIDADE TECIDUAL NA DURABILIDADE DOS RESULTADOS ESTÉTICOS
abstractText: A bioestimulação de colágeno compreende intervenções destinadas a produzir remodelamento progressivo do tecido cutâneo por interação entre biomateriais, imunidade local e atividade fibroblástica. A formação de novas fibras não corresponde, necessariamente, à regeneração funcional da matriz dérmica. Objetiva-se analisar criticamente a influência de fibroblastos, mediadores inflamatórios, organização extracelular e características individuais sobre a qualidade tecidual e a durabilidade estética, com ênfase no ácido poli-L-láctico, na hidroxiapatita de cálcio e na policaprolactona. Desenvolveu-se revisão sistematizada qualitativa com síntese narrativa, apoiada em fontes bibliográficas verificadas e busca dirigida, sem triagem exaustiva ou metanálise. A literatura registra remodelamento histológico e benefícios clínicos em indicações específicas, mas apresenta heterogeneidade de desenhos, instrumentos e seguimentos. Estudos mecanísticos não demonstram, isoladamente, duração clínica; ensaios e revisões clínicas tampouco atestam recuperação integral da matriz. Conclui-se que a persistência do resultado depende do material, da resposta biológica, do sítio anatômico, do estado inicial da pele e da qualidade das medidas utilizadas. Uma avaliação adequada deve integrar benefícios estéticos, propriedades estruturais e monitoramento de riscos.

title: Instrumentos para evaluar la imagen corporal en mujeres con mastectomía
abstractText: Resumen Introducción: la imagen corporal en mujeres con mastectomía es un constructo multidimensional estrechamente relacionado con el bienestar emocional y la calidad de vida, el cual se ve significativamente afectado por los cambios físicos derivados del cáncer de mama y sus tratamientos. Objetivo: identificar los instrumentos utilizados para evaluar la imagen corporal en mujeres con mastectomía, así como describir las adaptaciones y validaciones para cada país. Metodología: se realizó una revisión de alcance en PubMed y BVS para identificar artículos publicados en inglés y español entre 1993 y 2025, la selección se basó en criterios de población, concepto y contexto, siguiendo las directrices de Joanna Briggs Institute. La búsqueda inicial identificó 79 artículos; tras la evaluación por dos revisores independientes, se incluyeron 14 artículos. Resultados: se identificaron tres instrumentos principales el body image scale (α = 0.93), el más utilizado a nivel internacional; el body image after breast cancer questionnaire (α = 0.77-0.99) y el body image satisfaction scale (α = 0.70-0.90). Asimismo, se encontraron adaptaciones culturales y lingüísticas como la versión coreana del body image after mastectomy scale. Los estudios incluidos evidencian una amplia distribución geográfica. Conclusión: el body image scale es el instrumento más utilizado en las investigaciones identificadas para evaluar la imagen corporal en mujeres con mastectomía; sin embargo, persisten limitaciones en su validación cultural en diversos contextos. Aunque existen herramientas más específicas, su uso es limitado, evidenciando la necesidad de instrumentos culturalmente adaptados y validados para la población mexicana. title: Dampak Adopsi Kendaraan Listrik terhadap Konsumsi Listrik di Indonesia
abstractText: This study aims to: (1) estimate and empirically test the effect of electric vehicle adoption on electricity consumption in Indonesia, (2) measure the magnitude of the effect of electric vehicle charging infrastructure on electricity consumption, and (3) examine the effect of government policy on electricity consumption in Indonesia. This thesis employs quantitative research with a descriptive and verification approach. This study utilizes secondary data obtained from various official and verified sources, with panel data covering 38 provinces in Indonesia during the 2020–2024 period. The analytical techniques used include classical assumption tests and panel econometric models to analyze the relationship between electric vehicle (EV) adoption and electricity consumption in Indonesia. In processing panel data (data across time and across provinces), a panel regression model with fixed effects was used. The results show that: (1) electric vehicles have a positive effect on electricity consumption, (2) electric vehicle charging infrastructure has a positive and significant effect on electricity consumption, with a stronger level of significance than electric vehicles in certain models, and (3) government policy has a negative and significant effect on electricity consumption.

title: From:/To: Video Letters
abstractText: From:/To: Video Letters traces an exchange of intimate, self-reflexive video letters between two old friends - a visual artist and an arts researcher — over the course of a year. The work mobilises the letter form as an imaginal letter-writing exercise in which meaning emerges through relational address, temporal exchange, and exploratory poetics. Situated at the intersection of the essay film, documentary, and video art, From:/To: develops videographic epistolarity as a creative mode of audiovisual inquiry into subjectivity, affect, and the unstable relationship between words and images. Ultimately, it foregrounds friendship as an encounter open to difference, surprise, and the unpredictable rhythm of deferred exchange.
